notes.title: Armello v2.0 Launches Feb 26th PT, Beta Launches Tonight!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iY4Z85Q.gif[/img]

[h1]From death life flourishes and thus the dance of fate swirls anew, are you prepared to unearth Armello's bright new beginnings?

Armello is reborn on Steam, February 26th[/h1]

[url=armello.com/v2][img]https://i.imgur.com/xUyLtAt.png[/img][/url]

[h1]v2.0? What's in it?![/h1]
See the website for a full feature list including patch notes, [url=armello.com/v2]here[/url].


[h1]How do I access Armello v2.0?[/h1]

On the 26th of February Pacific Time (likely in the evening), v2.0 will go live on Steam for everyone that owns Armello. From this date onward, simply ensure that your client is up to date and you will have access to all of the juicy new features associated with v2.0.

To join in earlier, keep an eye out for the Open Beta, which will be going live [b]later today[/b].


[h1]Do I have to pay for v2.0?[/h1]

Nope! v2.0 is a completely free update that applies to all players for no charge. This update isn’t about premium content that some can purchase, it’s an update about adding community requested features, along with others we know you’ll love, to the core game for everyone to enjoy.

Don’t worry about Skeeve’s children, they will be fine.


[h1]Dice Skins I've purchased are now available to unlock through gameplay, what gives?![/h1]

Our latest premium dice skins hit the store years ago, and we're doing our best to scale back smaller purchasable options in Armello. We think that this is the correct move and it's a better time than ever to take the plunge.

If you purchased any these, we sincerely appreciate the support and thank you for having our backs. They will remain unlocked without you having to complete the required challenges.


[h1]Will we see more DLC for Armello?[/h1]

We have many stories that we want to tell, and we're not quite done tellin' 'em yet. We are very interested in adding DLC in some way or another at some stage. Naturally nothing is set in stone, until it is.


[h1]Is v2.0 coming to console?[/h1]

Long story short(er), yes. We very much intend to bring v2.0 to Switch, Xbox One and PS4, though we are in the midst of sorting out resourcing and timelines. Naturally we are currently attending to the existing issues on Switch as a priority above this, but it’ll happen.

It’s less a matter of if, and more a matter of when.


[h1]Is v2.0 coming to mobile?[/h1]

We would like to, though we are genuinely unsure at this time. The mobile version of Armello is an interesting beast and is very different to develop for. Crunching Armello down into those little devices is a feat that we don’t know that we can undertake for v2.0, and some of the core features, such as many of the menu overhauls, wouldn’t translate seamlessly.

We’re going to evaluate our options and let you know when we can.


[h1]When are you fixing the Switch issues?[/h1]

We are working on it as we speak. In tandem with v2.0 on Steam, we are fighting to get a new build out on Switch as a priority. Unfortunately due to the nature of console patches, once we resolve the issue and test it thoroughly, we still need to go through a submission process with Nintendo. Due to that, we can’t be sure when the build will actually land in your hands.

Thank you to everyone who has reached out with more information about the crashes that you have been experiencing on Switch, hopefully we can give you some good news soon.


[h1]Why did you focus on X when I wanted Y?[/h1]

Folks are naturally going to want to see all different things in a highly anticipated update like this, and whilst we try, we can’t get to everything. For this major update, we’ve attended to the very skeleton of Armello, areas that would be really meaningful for old and new players alike.

For v2.0 specifically our focus has been features surrounding quality of life, user experience and meta loop. Infrastructure like reconnection is in many cases an expectation/requirement for some players, though incredibly complex to implement. We’re proud that we can provide it.


[h1]What’s to come for Armello post-v2.0[/h1]

Let's just say that we've got a trick or two up our sleeve yet.

notes.title: Armello’s new dice collection, Mountain’s Hoard is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1k2TcDW1gg1CLZ7by1/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Good day kind people![/h1]

The day is upon us! A whole new chest, full of all new dice have landed in Armello. Complete multiplayer games to find Boreal Chests and remember to visit Skeeve’s Shop up to once a day to get freebies. Get in there and complete your collection!

With this collection comes a few bug fixes. Please find the patch notes for this little update below.

Happy gaming and may the RNG be in your favour. If you have any questions, let ‘em fly!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG crew[/h1]




[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]"Mountain's Hoard" Dice Collection is now live! Featuring new rare, epic and legendary dice.
[*]'Find Parties' Multiplayer option set to on by default.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fury Friday timer can no longer be extended indefinitely by refusing palace entry.
[*]Resolved an issue where using Hero Powers at the very end of a turn would result in an NMA (no more action softlock).
[*]Playing Teleport into a tile occupied by a stealthed character no longer incorrectly initiates combat and now correctly reveals the stealthed character.
[*]Entering GDPR offline mode will now correctly remove you from Multiplayer Matchmaking.
[*]Controller support is now available for the 'Find Parties' toggle option.
[*]Ghor's hero power will no longer be deactivated by losing/expiring health due to a buff expiry.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could no longer return to Prologue Act 1 after completing Prologue Act 4.
[*]Fixed an isue where some players could not claim their Daily Chest while using a controller.
[*]Fixed an issue where players would recieve no penalty for abandoning Multiplayer games.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]The King's Declaration phase in Fury Mode may sometimes has a very short timer.
[*]Dice/Chests in the Inventory screen may incorrectly show the 'Not Marketable'/ 'Not Tradeable'  tags when they are able traded and put on the Marketplace.
[*]If you fail to accept a mulitplayer game ready up, theres a chance your UI will lock up and require client restart
[/list]

[h1]Hello one and all![/h1]

The exciting news is out, and that is that the brand new dice collection, Mountain’s Hoard will be available on Steam from [b]Monday the 17th of December[/b]. That’s a shiny new set, from commons to the fabled legendary.

This means you only have a few days to wrap up your Star Seer’s Heirloom collection, so get in there and rumble with the King. If you desperately need to finish your collection and you just don’t have the time, remember that you can hit up the Steam Marketplace to wheel and deal these chests and dice. notes.title: v2.0 is Coming Q1 of 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/24bf007bac4a43ad394fc7466b032504c74cd56b.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy Friends,[/h1]

Hope you’re all well. As you may have heard we’ve been hard at work, charging towards the big v2.0 update for Armello. Thank you for all of your suggestions in the glorious suggestion thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/0/1700542968200640099/]here[/url], this really assisted us in understanding your expectations and your deepest darkest DESIRES!

As you know we wanted to get v2.0 in your hands by the end of the year, but that date has now been revised to Q1 of 2019 for Steam. The v2.0 update is one we're taking really seriously here at LoG and we’re excited about meeting and exceeding your expectations. We’ve made some decisions this year (like bringing Client Servers in early) that steer v2.0 into the new year, but rest assured this will be our chunkiest, glorious...est, free update ever.

Sincere apologies to anyone disappointed by the delay and thank you for your patience as we charge ahead on making all of the things. As always, we’ll come to you with more information when we can.

[h1]As the schedule has been shaken up a little, I am happy to confirm today that a new build, including a shiny new Dice Collection (and a bunch of quality of life bug fixes) will be landing on Steam before 2019.[/h1]

If you have any questions please let’em fly! I'm happy to answer what I can.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy @ LoG[/h1]

notes.title: The History of Multiplayer in Armello
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/24bf007bac4a43ad394fc7466b032504c74cd56b.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy folks![/h1]

We have something really special here today. We've mentioned previously that we'd like to share more information about how our multiplayer systems work, and here we have it.

Here's a history and retrospective of the Multiplayer systems in Armello, written by our lead developer, Karl Burdack.


[h1]The History of Multiplayer in Armello[/h1]


How did it take 3 years for Armello to transition from ‘Peer to Peer’, to ‘Cloud Hosted Dedicated Servers’?

The short answer is we were always busy, fixing issues, adding features for monthly updates, or porting to new platforms. We were also a very small team, of four permanent coders.

The rest of this article is the long answer! 

It’s been a winding path for Armello Multiplayer. As a studio, we have learnt much in three years about how to deliver updates to a live game. However we recognise there are still many improvements to be made.

[b]NMA’s[/b]

The biggest issue for Armello Multiplayer has been deadlocks in the gameplay event queue. The event queue is a list of actions, or rules, the game takes to move the game forward. They are executed one by one. 

If an event does not complete, the next event cannot begin. These are seen as freezes in gameplay, that we refer to as ‘NMA’ which is short for ‘No More Actions’. These freezes mostly affect multiplayer, since they occur when one peer’s version of events go out of sync with another, or a bug in our code fails to complete an event.

An analogy, would be if you played a physical board game. Where one of the four players, on their turn, could draw cards then take 3 actions. If that player sat at the table and refused to finish drawing their cards (NMA), all the other players would wait forever for their turn, and get very annoyed!

[b]September 2015: Version 1.0: Photon Matchmaking[/b]

As a beginning, let’s start with the first full public release of Armello, Version 1.0.

The first Armello multiplayer architecture operated by relying on Photon Relay servers. The Relay Server receives messages from players in a match, and then sends those messages in a consistent order to all players. We also had an optimization for when the local player was having a turn, that they would immediately execute their actions, eliminating latency.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q72hV1H.jpg[/img]

[u]Remaining Issues:[/u]

[list]
[*] Players would timeout and be disconnected after only approx 10 seconds of lost connection. This was a limitation where Photon could not be configured to behave differently.
[*] It did not support future improvements to Matchmaking we had planned, such as ranked matchmaking, in a way compatible with how we wanted to implement it.
[*] This system had no way to block cheaters, issue bans, or prevent pirate copies of the game from playing.
[/list]


[b]January 2016: Version 1.2: Steam Matchmaking and Peer to Peer[/b]

We evaluated the Steam Matchmaking and Peer to Peer (P2P) Networking, and decided it was more flexible and suited our future needs.

After implementation we immediately saw improvements in latency and connection timeout tolerance. Steam matchmaking also automatically blocked banned, or pirated copies joining multiplayer.

Changing to Steam P2P networking, transitioned Armello to a pure Peer to Peer network architecture. 

In order to support reliably ordered messages across all the peers, we had to continue to use a Relay for messages. So instead of using Photon Relay Servers, we now hosted the relay on one of the peers. This peer would be picked at the start of the match, and would remain the Relay host for the remainder of the match

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a0ADrGx.jpg[/img]

[u]Remaining Issues[/u]
The biggest issue with this change, was that dealing with disconnects became much harder. If the current Relay host (Amber) were to disconnect, a new peer needs to be consistently chosen, and all messages that were outgoing from the previous host at the time of disconnection, need to be reconciled in case any were lost to some players. It’s likely that Amber disconnecting while Thane takes an action, might let Thane execute his own action (red arrow) but for the message to never arrive at Sana or Mercurio (black arrows).

This lead to difficult issues for us down the road.

[b]June 2016: Version 1.4: Optimized networking[/b]

For 6 months, part of the Armello team were focused on porting to the Xbox One. Unfortunately, at that time Photon was not available for Xbox One. So in order to support that platform, we had to port the multiplayer to support a third solution: Unity Networking. 

Unity Networking on Xbox One at the time, had much stricter message size limits. So we had to get serious about optimizing Armello’s sloppy network message sizes. It’s something we had on our list of things to do, and now it had become a priority.

In many cases, these optimizations reduced the amount of data sent and received by a factor of 100. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nxavLUZ.jpg[/img]

What?  How could a simple Move action in a turn based game, consume 2500 bytes.  Easily:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uk882VD.jpg[/img]

These optimizations were easy to bring over to the Steam release of 1.4. It would also be an important optimization down the road for Mobile platforms. These optimizations have benefited players on connections with poor bandwidth, as well as reducing CPU overhead on below minimum spec machines. 

Unknown to us at the time, would be that the initial Unity Networking port to the Xbox One, would also be useful when starting out implementing dedicated servers!

[b]Jan 2017: Version 1.6: Multiplayer Stability Update[/b]

Poor disconnect handling had now been plaguing our multiplayer community for 6 months, and we began work on an improved model for the Peer to Peer Relay Host

An example of how disconnect could cause stability issues:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/E3A9Jg7.jpg[/img]

In this situation, the system must be designed to recover the message Thane had sent, and re-send it to Sana. If the message is not recovered correctly, it can lead to an NMA situation.

To address these inconsistencies with disconnections, we implemented improvements to how disconnections were handled. We implemented a better message tagging and reliable message recovery protocol. A simplified example of how lost messages are recovered is shown below:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UPy70PL.jpg[/img]

[u]Remaining Issues:[/u]

While this was promoted as a Multiplayer Stability Update. Many players complained that it made their experience worse. We reflected on two areas of weakness where we must improve:
[list]
[*] Measurement: We must be able to better measure build stability during development (testing), and in live builds (analytics)
[*] Automated testing: We must automate the testing process of multiplayer, so that an enormous volume of games can be played, testing all possible combinations of actions.
[*] ‘Double disconnect’: There were many cases where if two peers disconnected rapidly, our implementation would not handle it well. We would need to add automated tests for this case.
[*] Undetected by us at the time, was that the optimization of immediately executing the local players action (indicated with red arrow in previous images), was also the cause of much of the disconnect instability, due to ordering issues when switching hosts.
[/list]


[b]May 2017: Version 1.7: Automated Testing[/b]

After the disappointing results of 1.6, we worked for around 6 months to implement an automated testing system for Armello. We added support for multiplayer Bots which would play fully through games many times a day.

Immediately we found an enormous volume of NMA bugs. We were now able to more easily address these, with full logging from all our test agents. During this period, we released several patches, usually once a week, as we found and fixed the issues.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/43TLKXU.jpg[/img]
[i]Automated test PC's. These nifty HP micro PC's have a low power usage, but enough CPU power to run several tests of Armello in parallel, usually without graphics.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G4RWwlv.jpg[/img]

[u]Remaining Issues:[/u]
[list]
[*] After this round of patching, disconnections remained the major cause of instability, and we determined to look at this next.
[*] Analytics were still lacking enough detail for us to track live build stability.
[/list]

[b]August 2017: Version 1.9: Improved Disconnect Stability[/b]

We hooked up our automated tests to live analytics, so that we could analyze thousands of test games per day. We increased our test coverage to include disconnection. We also began to receive our first live Analytics for live build stability, and were able to track live issues, and our progress at reducing instability.

What we discovered was that the most common stability issues arose when players disconnected during the end of their turn.  In many cases, the issue was related to the ordering of remote messages, compared to the locally executed message (indicated in red in previous images) 

The fix was for players to take turns being the relay Host. The player who was having their turn would have the active Relay host, which would dispatch messages to all other hosts. When players end their turn, the active host moves to the next player. 

This way, the active player, would continue to always immediately execute actions on their turn, such as movement.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j8ap7r7.jpg[/img]

[u]Problems:[/u]
[list]
[*] Multiple players disconnecting at the same time were still causing stability issues, which were difficult to address easily with our existing peer to peer architecture and certain game events. 
[/list]

November 2017: Internal Prototype of Dedicated Servers.

We were faced with a choice, continue to improve the peer to peer model, while fixing issues in very complex Armello game code. Or look at all the issues as a whole, and decide on the best outcome going forward.

We decided to prototype Armello running with a Client/Server networking architecture. We would begin to look into the costs of hosting dedicated servers.

Fortunately, Armello was already well suited to Client/Server architecture, because it already broke up actions into discrete events which execute one after the other in a deterministic way on all clients. Deterministic means: The results of the action executing is exactly the same on all clients.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kOcyPSN.jpg[/img]

Initial prototyping was promising, but some additional problems would need to be overcome:
[list]
[*] A hosting service for the servers would need to be found
[*] Server hosting costs would need to be evaluated. As every hour of a dedicated server costs money. We didn’t want to dramatically burden our indie game with an unsustainable cost for running multiplayer.
[*] The server version of the game would need to be heavily optimized for CPU usage, Memory Usage, and build size. So that it could be more cheaply hosted.
[*] Latency for the active player would be unacceptable for some players. Additional work would need to be done to hide the latency by allowing the player to move, and revert that action if the server decided differently.
[/list]

[b]February 2018: Version 1.10, iOS Port[/b]

When porting to iOS, we needed a new, non-steam inventory and online account management service. We decided to integrate a service named ‘PlayFab’. 

This work turned out to have a fortuitous benefit; because PlayFab would later become our cloud hosting service for Dedicated Servers on the PC platform. We now had the final piece of technology required to make this happen.

[h1]Planning for Version 2.0[/h1]

For our planning for 2.0, we surveyed our community, what changes they would suggest for Armello 2.0. When we looked at the top 5 multiplayer related requests:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LhjWu4a.jpg[/img]

The number one requested feature, was Multiplayer Reconnect. This is a feature that would allow players to rejoin a game that had already begun, after they were disconnected for some reason. Also note resolving NMA’s as 4th on the list. 

We also keep an eye on our monthly negative reviews, here is an example from April 2018:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MG3O6xQ.jpg[/img]

This month is fairly typical for reviews. 25% of negative reviews are attributable to NMAs. Also, 8% of players gave us a negative review for lack of a Reconnect feature.

Many of the complaints are down to taste, such as Randomness (RNG). However NMAs and Reconnection are something we can improve, without fundamentally changing the game of Armello.

[list]
[*] Reconnect: This is by far simpler with a Client/Server architecture. Where the Server has a complete copy of the game, which can be replicated to clients attempting to reconnect. If we are ever to support this feature, we would first need working dedicated servers.
[*] Resolve NMAs: We knew that the ongoing difficulty with testing and preventing NMA’s would be much simpler in a client/server architecture. In particular, having a dedicated server does away with the problem of a ‘host’ disconnecting completely.
[/list]

With solid information backing our instincts, we knew changing to Dedicated Servers might be the most important change to Armello we could make.


[b]July 2018: Version 1.12: Dedicated Server Beta.[/b]

For the first 6 months of 2018, we worked on fully implementing Client/Server in Armello. This included:
[list]
[*] Setting up the backend technology to let us easily upload new builds of the server into the cloud. (PlayFab)
[*] Developing optimizing builds of Armello to be hosted in the cloud as a server.
[*] Improving disconnect to take advantage of the stable dedicated server.
[*] Repurposing our automated testing, to be testing hundreds of cloud hosted games a day, and to pressure test the cloud hosting service.
[*] Improving client side movement actions to hide latency
[*] Fixing a whole bunch more NMA’s along the way.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]August 2018: Version 1.12.1, Patch 4: Dedicated Servers switched on permanently[/b]

After about 4 weeks of beta testing the dedicated servers.  We switched them on for all multiplayer games on 20th August.

The following chart tracks server load time over 30 days, which is a good measure of performance.  In this chart, the lower the line, the faster servers are launching into games.  In the first few weeks, we had to work hard to eliminate issues where servers would crash, or freeze.  We also had to tune the load balancing of how many game servers were allocated per cloud machine.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ALdnCju.jpg[/img]

By the first week of september, in Patch 7, we had resolved all known crash issues, and had load tested the server into a stable configuration.  From Patch 7 onward, server load times, and availability have been rock solid.

One of our reasons to switch to dedicated servers, was increased match stability, by reducing NMA rates. Now that dedicated servers are fully operating, we can compare public multiplayer games completed against those that failed to complete because of an NMA.  The following chart shows 30 days of games, with the transition from Peer to Peer to Dedicated Servers marked in red.  Note the significant decrease in NMA’s as a percentage of games (in light blue):

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RhF4kyj.jpg[/img]

We are very happy with these results.  And we hope our players are too!  More games are being completed than ever before, with stability issues such as NMA’s and disconnects at all time lows.

[b]The future[/b]

While we aren’t promising anything (when do we ever do that?), having dedicated servers does open up some interesting future possibilities for Armello beyond adding reconnect capability. We will be announcing some of these in future. In the meantime, keep the suggestions coming!


[h1]- Karl & the LoG Team[/h1]

The biggest issue with this change, was that dealing with disconnects became much harder. If the current Relay host (Amber) were to disconnect, a new peer needs to be consistently chosen, and all messages that were outgoing from the previous host at the time of disconnection, need to be reconciled in case any were lost to some players. It’s likely that Amber disconnecting while Thane takes an action, might let Thane execute his own action (red arrow) but for the message to never arrive at Sana or Mercurio (black arrows).
In this situation, the system must be designed to recover the message Thane had sent, and re-send it to Sana. If the message is not recovered correctly, it can lead to an NMA situation.
While this was promoted as a Multiplayer Stability Update. Many players complained that it made their experience worse. We reflected on two areas of weakness where we must improve:
‘Double disconnect’: There were many cases where if two peers disconnected rapidly, our implementation would not handle it well. We would need to add automated tests for this case.

Undetected by us at the time, was that the optimization of immediately executing the local players action (indicated with red arrow in previous images), was also the cause of much of the disconnect instability, due to ordering issues when switching hosts.

Immediately we found an enormous volume of NMA bugs. We were now able to more easily address these, with full logging from all our test agents. During this period, we released several patches, usually once a week, as we found and fixed the issues.
After this round of patching, disconnections remained the major cause of instability, and we determined to look at this next.
Analytics were still lacking enough detail for us to track live build stability.

What we discovered was that the most common stability issues arose when players disconnected during the end of their turn. In many cases, the issue was related to the ordering of remote messages, compared to the locally executed message (indicated in red in previous images)
Multiple players disconnecting at the same time were still causing stability issues, which were difficult to address easily with our existing peer to peer architecture and certain game events.
A hosting service for the servers would need to be found

Server hosting costs would need to be evaluated. As every hour of a dedicated server costs money. We didn’t want to dramatically burden our indie game with an unsustainable cost for running multiplayer.
The server version of the game would need to be heavily optimized for CPU usage, Memory Usage, and build size. So that it could be more cheaply hosted.

Latency for the active player would be unacceptable for some players. Additional work would need to be done to hide the latency by allowing the player to move, and revert that action if the server decided differently.

The number one requested feature, was Multiplayer Reconnect. This is a feature that would allow players to rejoin a game that had already begun, after they were disconnected for some reason. Also note resolving NMA’s as 4th on the list.
25% of negative reviews are attributable to NMAs. Also, 8% of players gave us a negative review for lack of a Reconnect feature.

Reconnect: This is by far simpler with a Client/Server architecture. Where the Server has a complete copy of the game, which can be replicated to clients attempting to reconnect. If we are ever to support this feature, we would first need working dedicated servers.

Resolve NMAs: We knew that the ongoing difficulty with testing and preventing NMA’s would be much simpler in a client/server architecture. In particular, having a dedicated server does away with the problem of a ‘host’ disconnecting completely.
Setting up the backend technology to let us easily upload new builds of the server into the cloud. (PlayFab)
Developing optimizing builds of Armello to be hosted in the cloud as a server.
Improving disconnect to take advantage of the stable dedicated server.
Repurposing our automated testing, to be testing hundreds of cloud hosted games a day, and to pressure test the cloud hosting service.
Improving client side movement actions to hide latency
Fixing a whole bunch more NMA’s along the way.
In the first few weeks, we had to work hard to eliminate issues where servers would crash, or freeze. We also had to tune the load balancing of how many game servers were allocated per cloud machine.

By the first week of september, in Patch 7, we had resolved all known crash issues, and had load tested the server into a stable configuration. From Patch 7 onward, server load times, and availability have been rock solid.
Note the significant decrease in NMA’s as a percentage of games (in light blue):

tags.feature: - Changing to Steam P2P networking, transitioned Armello to a pure Peer to Peer network architecture.

- For 6 months, part of the Armello team were focused on porting to the Xbox One. Unfortunately, at that time Photon was not available for Xbox One. So in order to support that platform, we had to port the multiplayer to support a third solution: Unity Networking.

- After the disappointing results of 1.6, we worked for around 6 months to implement an automated testing system for Armello. We added support for multiplayer Bots which would play fully through games many times a day.

- We hooked up our automated tests to live analytics, so that we could analyze thousands of test games per day. We increased our test coverage to include disconnection. We also began to receive our first live Analytics for live build stability, and were able to track live issues, and our progress at reducing instability.

- The fix was for players to take turns being the relay Host. The player who was having their turn would have the active Relay host, which would dispatch messages to all other hosts. When players end their turn, the active host moves to the next player.
- We decided to prototype Armello running with a Client/Server networking architecture. We would begin to look into the costs of hosting dedicated servers.
- When porting to iOS, we needed a new, non-steam inventory and online account management service. We decided to integrate a service named ‘PlayFab’.

- This work turned out to have a fortuitous benefit; because PlayFab would later become our cloud hosting service for Dedicated Servers on the PC platform. We now had the final piece of technology required to make this happen.
- For our planning for 2.0, we surveyed our community, what changes they would suggest for Armello 2.0. When we looked at the top 5 multiplayer related requests:
- For the first 6 months of 2018, we worked on fully implementing Client/Server in Armello. This included:
- After about 4 weeks of beta testing the dedicated servers. We switched them on for all multiplayer games on 20th August.

tags.balance_change: - Players would timeout and be disconnected after only approx 10 seconds of lost connection. This was a limitation where Photon could not be configured to behave differently.
- It did not support future improvements to Matchmaking we had planned, such as ranked matchmaking, in a way compatible with how we wanted to implement it.
- After implementation we immediately saw improvements in latency and connection timeout tolerance. Steam matchmaking also automatically blocked banned, or pirated copies joining multiplayer.
- In many cases, these optimizations reduced the amount of data sent and received by a factor of 100.
- These optimizations have benefited players on connections with poor bandwidth, as well as reducing CPU overhead on below minimum spec machines.

- To address these inconsistencies with disconnections, we implemented improvements to how disconnections were handled. We implemented a better message tagging and reliable message recovery protocol. A simplified example of how lost messages are recovered is shown below:

- We increased our test coverage to include disconnection. We also began to receive our first live Analytics for live build stability, and were able to track live issues, and our progress at reducing instability.

- One of our reasons to switch to dedicated servers, was increased match stability, by reducing NMA rates. Now that dedicated servers are fully operating, we can compare public multiplayer games completed against those that failed to complete because of an NMA. notes.title: Stability, Reintroducing Party Queuing and the Updates Ahead!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/24bf007bac4a43ad394fc7466b032504c74cd56b.png[/img]

[h1]Hi, hello![/h1]

I'm here to talk about a few hot topics, and I've got some great news for all of you. Primarily I'm going to chat about Multiplayer Stability and our plans to reintroduce Party Queuing.

Just quickly in case you weren't in the loop, [b]v2.0 is scheduled for late this year[/b]. Let the hype grow within.

As always, if you have any questions please feel free to hit the comments below. Make yourself a cup of tea and let's get into it.

[h1]Multiplayer Stability[/h1]
According to our analytics, Armello is officially more stable than it's ever been. Talkin’ specifics, the game completion rate is far better than it’s ever been, and NMAs (no more action soft-locks) have reduced by over 1500%. That’s *big*.

Why, you ask? Well kind friends, our new Dedicated Servers are to thank. Their introduction was a little rocky, we know, but we're really thankful we weathered the storm as we're currently living in a new, stable future.

For those keen on more details, including juicy numbers, LoG lead developer, Karl Burdack, is preparing an in-depth retrospective of our multiplayer services - why we made certain decisions, what bugs arose and the actions we've taken over the years to make improvements. This will be released in the form of an extensive Steam announcement over the next week or so, so keep an eye out for that. 

[h1]Party Queuing[/h1]
[b]Party Queuing is coming back to Armello.[/b] With the implementation of the new Dedicated Server tech and new multiplayer menu flow, the functionality of queuing for public games as a party of 2-3 was removed. We were comfortable releasing a build like this, as a large complaint had been that friends were relentlessly and unfairly targeting solo players, in the hopes of benefiting their "team".

Much like any tabletop game where several players gang up on one player, this isn't fun.

Naturally we understand that the majority of friends jumping into the public queue together do play Armello in the spirit it was intended, and the feedback we received after the change addressing teaming was clear. Armello was always intended to be played with friends, and we need a solution that caters for folks who want to queue with their pals, whilst protecting folks from being matched with malicious teamers.

This issue is inherently dividing. Some like how it is now, and others like how it was. So the big question was, [b]why can't we have both?[/b] Well, you can. 

[h1]Matchmaking with Parties will be an option that can be toggled on and off at will.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/6b114644e7568c4638ec30d0b77d0914f364afc5.png[/img]
[i]PLEASE NOTE: This is a work in process screenshot. Final implementation may vary, including wording etc.[/i]


If you'd prefer to match with solo players only, turn Find Parties off. If you don't mind the possibility of being matched with a party of 2-3 players and are looking for the fastest queue times, then turn Find Parties on. Simple as that!

This solution provides choice, and puts the power in your hands to play as you like. Please also know that this whole system will be improved for v2.0, which makes it the [b]perfect time to give us feedback![/b] We're excited about it and I hope you are too.

[h1]Okay so when?![/h1]

An update will come out [b]within the next few weeks[/b], reintroducing the ability to matchmake as a party of 2-3 players. We'll shout loudly when it happens to let you know. From then, we'll be here with fixes and improvements where necessary, but we'll also be hard at work focusing on hot secret content for v2.0.


That's it! I hope this news is well received because the LoG squad is fighting to restore and protect Armello for every type of player. Whether it's stability or queuing, we're out here listening, looking for the best solutions. We hope you appreciate it.

As always, if I can help with anything please hit me up.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

EDIT: Clarity

An update will come out within the next few weeks, reintroducing the ability to matchmake as a party of 2-3 players.

notes.title: July Update - Hotfix 4
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jDJe2Oi.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello and welcome![/h1]

A hot little hotfix is out and about as of a few hours ago, and this specifically to address bugs with the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/0/1746720717339241296/]Dedicated Servers[/url] for the most part. We're getting close to comfortably leaving the Dedicated Servers on indefinitely, which is exciting. We'll be running some more tests this week so hopefully you can't even tell, but please report any weirdness you encounter!

[h1]ICYMI Dedicated Servers are...[/h1]
a format of multiplayer, where players connect to an external server to host multiplayer games. Previously, our multiplayer servers have been Peer to Peer, meaning you would connect directly to other players and there were no external servers whatsoever. This old format made NMAs and game breaking bugs more likely, so we're in the process of introducing a complete rearchitecture of our multiplayer systems to a Dedicated Server format.

We now have the ability to turn our new multiplayer tech on and off in the build seemlessly.

[h1]General Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue when continuing a saved game a "DLC unowned" error would pop up
[/list]

[h1]Dedicated Server Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where players would create Private game lobbies but get an endless loading spinner
[*]Fixed an issue where AI weren't able to choose King's Declarations
[*]Fixed various NMA's related to the card draw phase which would result in the game falling out of sync. The NMA could occur in various places throughout the game.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]NMA can occur if you hit End Turn just as your turn is about to expire
[*]If player leaves the game during your turn from a poor internet connection (not from Quitting the game) you may notice your next turn you're unable to do anything (the server is waiting for the player to return but the timer is still going).
[/list]


As always please feel free to hit me up if you have any questions.

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/smmYzdM.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]HOWDY![/h1]

Well, well, well. Here we are, a little late but here regardless. The July Update beta [b]just went live![/b] This build will feature the news cards, and will have a little more than what initially meets the eye. The new Collection won't kick off until the full launch on the 31st, instead we'll be running [b]double drops[/b] of the current collection, Skeeve's Curiosities.

This beta will include our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1689296019124416512]Dedicated Servers![/url][/b] Be sure to hit us with your feedback and discuss the differences

[h1]How do I get in there?![/h1]
All you have to do is navigate to your Steam Library and locate Armello and do the following...
[b]Right click Armello -> Properties -> Betas -> Select the open beta from the dropdown menu[/b]

This will download the beta version of Armello. Please be mindful that changing back will cause you to redownload the base game, if you're conscious of your downloads.

[h1]SUBMIT YOUR BUGS![/h1]
Please and thank you, you glorious individuals. Our QA team are the best of the best but anything can happen, so please be patient with us if you run into some weirdness. If something goes wrong, please submit an in-game bug report through the pause menu!

[i]Edited: 26/07 PST[/i]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]With the new server infrastructure, latency may fluctuate
[*]An odd text string may appear when loading into the main menu for non-English languages
[*]Rare NMA that may have to do with secret quests, we're currently investigating, send logs if you can!
[*]If a queue fails to ready up the players will need to exit and queue again[/list]

[h1]Double Drops![/h1]
Where there was one, there will instead be TWO chests. This bonus applies to the three chests that you can earn daily, and not to Skeeve's freebie. Soak up that scrumptious loot and hopefully you catch yourself an Abbott's Eye in the process!

As with everything, chat it out with us and each other! Keen to hear your thoughts.

[h1]Welcome![/h1]

[h1]What’s all this then?![/h1]

This new logic sparked the creation of our new Multiplayer menu flow and recent changes to party queueing. Now that we’ve stripped it all back, we have the opportunity to build it all back up, hopefully implementing queue options along the way that all different players can get behind.

It’s important to know that there will be bugs! Once again, [i]there will be bugs[/i], BUT we’re going to fix ‘em. Also, please know that we may need to turn the beta off for periods of time to make improvements. We’ll do our best to keep you in the loop.

notes.title: June Update Feature Reveal - Balance Pass
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iaz8dzH.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hello and welcome![/h1]

This is the first feature reveal for the June Update, landing on the 27th PT. The title "Balance Pass" probably doesn't accurately encompass how large an adjustment this is, so we're just going to share all of the gameplay adjustments we're making, including heroes, rings, amulets and card changes.

I don't know about you, but I'm hype. A [b]huge[/b] portion of these are community suggested or at least community inspired, so thank you for all of those who have been hittin' us with feedback.

[h1]Evade & Scout[/h1]
[list][*]Characters can no longer evade attacks from players that are scouting them. Effectively, evade is neutralised by Scout.[/list]

[h1]Bounties[/h1]
[list][*]Bounties triggered from attacking Creatures are now applied after the combat, rather than before.[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DEvzTlr.png[/img]

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
[list][*]Ghor Rework - Ghor’s Hero Power now reads and acts follows: 
Guardian - Ending his turn on a Forest makes Ghor immune to the next instance of damage (dawn Health loss from Rot still occurs).
[*]Twiss’ Stat array changed to 3F, 4B, 5W, 4S (from 2F, 5B, 5W, 4S) and is largely affected by the aforementioned Evade change. Twiss can no longer Evade when Scouted.
[*]Sylas is largely affected by the aforementioned Bounty change. Bounties will be applied after attacking King's Guards and The King.
[*]Barnaby now starts with 8 gold (up from 7).
[*]Elyssia now starts with 5 gold (down from 7).
[*]Sargon now starts with 6 gold (down from 7).[/list]

[h1]Rings[/h1]

[b]Rats[/b]
[list][*]Opal - Gain Stealth and +1 Sword in Settlements Day and Night.
([i]prev. Gain Stealth Sword in Settlements Day and Night.[/i])
[*]Obsidian - Gain Scout on all your claimed Settlements.
([i]prev. Gain Scout on all your claimed Settlements at night.[/i])
[*]Turquoise - Gain the Evade ability and +2 Explode Pool.
([i]prev. Gain the Evade ability[/i])
[*]Tanzanite - +2 Gold when you successfully escape a Peril.
([i]prev. +1 Gold when you successfully escape a Peril.[/i])[/list]

[b]Rabbits[/b]
[list][*]Rainbow Quartz - +1 Magic and +1 Gold every Dawn.
([i]prev. +1 Magic every Dawn[/i])
[*]Spinel - Get a 20% bonus in all Quest Tests.
([i]prev. Get a 10% bonus in all Quest Tests.[/i])[/list]

[b]Wolves[/b]
[list][*]Moonstone - Gain +2 Magic for any Kill in Battle. (up from 1)
[*]Onyx - Gain +2 Gold for any Kill in Battle. (up from 1)
[*]Chrysocolla - Grants scout on heroes with 3 Health or less. (up from 2)[/list]

[b]Bears[/b]
[list][*]Amethyst - Gain 1 Magic for every Spell card burned, +2 if its a Rot card.
([i]prev. Gain 1 Magic for every Spell card burned.[/i])
[*]Aquamarine - +1 Moon and +1 Explode Pool while you have 3 Rot or less.
([i]prev. +1 Moon while you have 3 Rot or less.[/i])
[*]Taaffeite - +1 Shield and +2 Explode Pool in Forests.
([i]prev. +1 Shield in Forests.[/i])[/list]

[b]Bandits[/b]
[list][*]Opal - Gain Stealth and +1 Sword in Settlements Day and Night
([i]As above[/i])
[*]Amethyst - Gain 1 Magic for every Spell card burned, +2 if its a Rot card.
([i]As above[/i])[/list]

[h1]Amulets[/h1]
[list][*]Listener - +1 Star after completed Multiplayer Games to show you're awesome!
([i]prev. nothing, lol.[/i])
[*]Dig - Gain +3 Gold for each Spirit Stone acquired.
([i]prev. Extra chance for Spirit Stones in Dungeons.[/i])
[*]Sprint - End your Turn with 1 or more unused Action Points to gain +1 Action Point next turn.
([i]This adjustment actually went live in a previous update, but we're reminding you again. <3[/i])
[*]Discipline - +2 Clan Affinity Dice Bonus.
([i]Up from 1[/i])
[*]Intimidate - End your turn next to a creature, they suffer -2 Dice in Battles, until the end of their next turn. (Also has received a visual overhaul)
([i]Up from 1[/i])
[*]Harmonise - While not Corrupt, in Battle, all Rot Cards in your hand change to Sun symbol.
([i]prev. When on 0 Rot, in Battles, all Rot Cards in your hand change to Sun symbols.[/i])[/list]

[h1]Cards[/h1]

[b]Items[/b]
[list][*]Lord's Sceptre - +1 Prestige for each Claimed Settlement and +1 Gold at Dawn.
([i]prev. +1 Prestige for each Claimed Settlement.[/i])
[*]Poisoned Dagger - In Battle, all rolled Swords gain Poison.
([i]prev. Burning a Rot in combat causes rolled Swords gain Poison.[/i])
[*]Hero's Shield (Treasure) - In Battle, +1 Reflect and +1 Dice.
([i]prev. In Battle, +1 Reflect.[/i])
[*]Bubble Tea - (Play on) Hero, +1 Prestige.
([i]prev. +1 Prestige until the end of next turn.[/i])
[*]Snake Venom - In Battle, all rolled Swords gain Poison, until the end of your next turn.
([i]prev. Burning a Rot in combat causes rolled Swords gain Poison, until the end of your next turn.[/i])
[*]Spy Glass now costs 1 Gold.
([i]down from 2 [/i])[/list]

[b]Spells[/b]
[list][*]Glamour now costs 1 Magic and has 4 instances in the deck.
([i]Cost down from 2, instances up from 2.[/i])
[*]Moonbite now costs 2 magic.
([i]up from 1[/i])
[*]Spirit Seeds - (Play on) Swamp; +5 Health to Creatures and grows a Forest 
([i]prev. Grows a Forest from a Swamp. Creatures on Tile gain 2 Health.[/i][/list]

[b]Trickery[/b]
[list][*]Beheaded - (Play on) Settlement, Dungeon, Hero; -2 Health per Follower target has recruited.
([i]prev. Kill a random follower.[/i])
[*]Wandering Circus - Now costs 2 gold, quantity increased to 4 - (Play on) Plains, Forest, Settlement; Steal 2 cards from target's Hand.
([i]Added Forest as a valid target tile, cost down from 3. Quantity up from 3. [/i])[/list]


OKAY so I know this was a lot. Soak it all up and let the discussions flow freely out of your minds and into the comments below. We'll see you soon.


[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]WHAT? WHY?[/b]
This balance pass is guided specifically by analytics surrounding player behaviour and game outcomes. The question "why the hell did you change that", in almost every case here is, because...
a. people aren't using the thing.
b. people aren't winning enough with the thing (relevant to other choices)
c. the thing is frustrating to play against
d. we see a great opportunity for the thing
e. a combination of the above

[b]Beheaded[/b]
The Follower economy in Armello is currently quite low, and Followers are outrageously fun. In some cases, they modify how heroes are played completely. The fun of removing someone else's Follower, doesn't outweigh the fun that you're deducting from the game as a whole.

Considering in some cases games end before two players have followers, we don't like the idea of having a card to kill followers, AND a different card to steal 'em. For now (everything is fluid, things can change), we're comfortable with Bribery being the go-to for Follower "removal". We'll monitor how this feels closely.

[b]Dig[/b]
This Amulet was straight up almost never picked, for good reason. The function is hard to quantify when you're in the thick of a game. There was no feedback as to how it was helping you, and there's a chance that it simply provided no benefit.

If you regularly use this Amulet, hello statistical anomaly, how are you today?

We're trying this option out for now to see if it feels fun and appealing. We also have another, heavier option that could be implemented at some stage either as an alternative or a rework.

[b]Twiss & Sylas[/b]
These two heroes are incredibly popular and powerful. Their win rates were simply too far outside of the norm to allow to cruise as they are. Their identities remain intact and they'll still be strong.

[b]Ghor[/b]
Ah, Ghor. When implementing a mechanic that reduced Spell cost, we never knew that he'd become such an antagonist. He basically suppressed other players by spamming nukes, but also at the same time had a really poor win rate.

This made him bad to play against, because you're like "damn this bear is going to just blast me from across the map" AND bad to play as, due to you being a target, no stealth yada yada. Basically his hero power didn't work, and wasn't a good reflection of his character thematically.

We've also noted that defensive hero powers are underexplored, and typically a lot of fun in Armello (see Twiss and Elyssia). Activating his new hero power is fun, and also makes for a really interesting decision space for his opponents.

Try it out, see how he feels. We think you'll like it.

armello.com/updates

[h1]Revel Armellians, the May Update is live![/h1]

This marks the fourth monthly update on the Road to 2.0 and we're not stopping yet. Ensure your Steam client is up to date and jump on in there and experience the shiny new bits and pieces.

If you're a human that enjoys reviewing build notes rather than my delicious descriptions, you can find 'em [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3728.0]here[/url]! Let's get stuck into the major three features for this update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VQAN0qf.gif[/img]

These two new Trickery cards are a contribution to the recently implemented Merchant system, but are a little more accessible for the cheaper adventurers out there. You can check out their original reveal post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1655515215461410893]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T6Y5Z8d.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lazQJCe.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wozs01S.gif[/img]

Two new House Rules will be landing in the May update! Hero AP and Mirror World.

[b]Hero AP[/b] is simple enough with two choices, +1 or +2. By selecting this option, every Hero in Armello will gain the relevant AP each turn.

The [b]Mirror World[/b] House Rule modifies the map generation, so one quarter of the map is mirrored to the other three corners. Every quarter of the board are configured identically, making each Hero's starting quadrant exactly the same. You can find the original announcement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1655515215465394094]here.[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8wGypaj.png[/img]

From there to read it, head to your inventory and open it up! You can find the original announcement post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1655515215471189085]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xAHb8AA.png[/img]

There we have it folks, hope you all dig the changes. The next update is never too far away too, so it's never too soon to start scheming, dreaming and suggesting. As always please hit us up on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] if that's up your alley and we'll see you soon.


Cheers,

notes.title: May Update Feature Reveal - House Rules
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wozs01S.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hello, hi![/h1]

Welcome to feature reveal number two for the May Update, landing on the 23rd PT. Here are a few House Rules that are being implemented that we've had a bunch of fun with. We're positive you will too.

We'll start with the simple one and then lead into the heavier one.

[h1]Hero AP[/h1]

This is pretty straight forward, the Hero AP House Rule contains two options, +1 and +2. Turn these on and every hero in the game will have 4 or 5 AP per turn.

No quests are too far when this rule is on.

[h1]Mirror World[/h1]

Map Generation shrouding your clan grounds in Swamps and Mountains?! Well now your opponents can suffer the same fate (yay).

The Mirror World House Rule modifies the map generation, so one quarter of the map is mirrored to the other three corners. Every quarter of the board are configured identically, making each Hero's starting quadrant exactly the same.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8dTeU1h.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8wGypaj.png[/img]


There we have it! These House Rules will be available upon the launch of the May Update and you can expect 'em to fold into Stranger Games rulesets. One feature remains so hold tight for the juicy details on that.


[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FMBaKYl.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

The time has finally come - Darcy is back! Oh, yeah, and the April Update is Live NOW! If you’re the type of person who likes to dig straight into the build notes, you can find them in all their glory [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?board=23.0]here.[/url]

Let’s run through all of the features that this release brought for you.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/uNWOIyT.gif[/img]

Mercurio’s story - The Grinning Blade is now out. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rhhsnJr.png[/img]


You can get this novella at Skeeve’s shop, where he’s giving it out for free (what a deal). Once collected, navigate to the Novella in your inventory to give it a read.

Our detailed post about the novella can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2857973322410990152]here.[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dUVnHYM.gif[/img]

Probably the most exciting part of this update - the changes to the Explode Pool. 

Each hero’s Explode Pool is now equal to their Spirit stat. If you’re Corrupted, your explode pool is based on the Rot value and not your Spirit. As a result some of the cards have been changed and new cards have been added.

Our post describing the mechanics of the explode pool and our motivation behind this decision is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2857973322429162587]here.[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d4hjB4L.gif[/img]

We have added 2 new cards to the game to complement the changes to the explode pool - Blackberry Dust and Mahogany Stuff. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QhqhnXi.gif[/img]

Blackburry Dust gives you +1 to Health and Magic but takes away 2 from the explode pool.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yGvOa1C.gif[/img]

Mahogany Stuff is an equipable item that gives +1 to Spirit and adds +1 to explode pool. 

Full description of the cards and their effects can be found in our post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437135631/announcements/detail/2857973322433731580]here.[/url]

Below is the list of the known bugs that might affect some players:
[list][*]In-game inventory might not reflect items you have but Steam will show them correctly
[*]Decay Amulet might apply damage incorrectly based on your rot level
[*]Pink (some say magenta) skins are still there. This colour is all the rage this season.
[*]King might not have Voice Over in the beginning of the game[/list]


This about wraps it up. Go ahead and try it out for yourself, hopefully we have covered everything in this post but as usual, your feedback is always welcome!

Mmmmmuch love,

[h1]<3 Lena & the LoG Team[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/d4hjB4L.gif[/img]

armello.com/update

[h1][b]Hello everybody![/b][/h1]

It’s Day 3 of the April Update Feature Reveal (and the last one before [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1657763842733951766]Beta[/url] is live) which will go live on April 25th, Pacific Time. Woohoo!

This is the third and final update for April and it goes along nicely with the big Explode Pool update from earlier. There are 2 cards that are being introduced to the game to complement the changes to the Explode Pool. 

[h1][b]First card is Blackberry Dust[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QhqhnXi.gif[/img]

This card is a fun one (besides the fact that it also looks delicious). You can use it on yourself to add +1 to Health and Magic but at the cost of -2 to Explode Pool, or you can throw some [strike]shade[/strike] dust on one of your opponents before attacking them. Add to it the fact that this card is free to use, and it looks like ‘Blackberry dust’ is bound to be floating over Armello quite frequently (or as frequently as possible).

[h1][b]Card number two is Mahogany Staff[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yGvOa1C.gif[/img]

This is an equipable item that would be good for a spell caster. It gives you +1 Spirit and adds +1 to your Explode Pool. It’ll also cost you some gold. So for a price of 4 gold, you can increase your Spirit, which, you guessed it, increases your Explode Pool, and then you can boost your Explode Pool even further! Amazing. We think that this way a caster can be more effective in combat.

And this wraps up all of the April updates. 

As usual, share your thoughts, ideas, feedback and don’t forget to play during the beta period (starting on April 18th PST) in preparation for the update. 

[i][b]Much love,[/b][/i] 

[h1][b]<3 Lena and the LoG Squad[/b][/h1]

notes.title: April Update Feature Reveal - Explode Pool
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dUVnHYM.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hi there![/h1]

Hope all is well! Our favourite community manager Darcy is enjoying some delicious foods in Taiwan and I'm posting this announcement on his behalf. And, oh boy, it's a big one!

As you already have gathered, this is the second feature reveal for the April Update. In case you missed it, this update will be coming out on the 25th of April (Pacific Time) and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1657763842733951766]Beta[/url] will go live on the 18th! It’s all happening! Have you cleared your schedules? It's not too late to do it now.

Today's feature reveal is pretty important -  a fundamental change to one of Armello’s core systems, the Explode system. To ensure that we’re all on the same page, the act of a dice “Exploding” is an additional reroll. Typically this happens when you roll a Wyld symbol, triggering a hit and an additional dice to spawn and roll. Previously Exploding dice could chain indefinitely... UNTIL NOW!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tfhoeHh.gif[/img]

Each Hero’s Explode Pool is equal to their Spirit stat. If your Spirit is 2, your dice will explode a maximum number of two times. Of course, you will be able to modify your explode pool through cards and effects, notably Corrupted heroes. A new effect of being Corrupted (gaining 5+ Rot) is that your explode pool will be based on Rot value, rather than your Spirit. Keep your keen eyes peeled for cards that may have undergone some adjustment…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AOLsck6.gif[/img]

Now let's talk about why this was done. This adjustment will allow players to further calculate and strategise. It limits the ceiling of what can happen, providing more room for foresight while stifling the ability for insane RNG to disrupt your seemingly safe plans. Put plainly, this is predominantly a move to reduce the chaos while preserving the fun of Explode chains for certain builds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YbXc3iA.gif[/img]

Also, we all know that it can feel terrible to have a King’s Guard roll 5 Wylds and Halberd you back to your Clan Grounds, but thankfully King’s Guards have a Spirit value of zero. This means that King’s Guards’ dice do not explode at all (!), whereas Banes who are Corrupted, have an explode pool equal to their Rot value. This solidifies King’s Guards as predictable bulky obstructions, while allowing Banes to be unpredictable. This change restores balance to the eternal battle of King’s Guards and Banes, bringing an unsettling harmony back to Armello.

If you have any questions, theories, strategies or thoughts, please share them below! We’re excited to hear what you think. Keep an eye out for the third and final feature reveal too, it’s not too far away.

Much love, 

[h1]<3 Lena and the LoG Squad[/h1]

[/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: The March Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/abCJYC2.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hello friends![/h1]

Are you ready, because the time has arrived. The March Update is live and you can jump in right now! Oh and if you missed it, a couple of pretty cool things happened this week Armello-wise. Armello is now available in official, physical, boxed form in stores around the world AND is available on iOS worldwide.
Check it out!

I'm going to run through all of the primary features to sink your teeth into. If you're the type of person who prefers to cut to the chase and look through the patch notes, [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3672.msg22994#msg22994]here you go[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AyUAhDJ.png[/img]
For the full details on this, check the dedicated post about the new Amulets [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1660013106943904302]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ChHHkYr.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aMnK5GE.gif[/img]

You can get this for free by simply visiting Skeeve's Shop, he will be happy to hand it over free of charge. All of the details can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1660013106949053654]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kwLzzO3.png[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/DObsHzv.gif[/img]

The Rites of Ruin collection has cycled out and the Skeeve's Curiosities collection has cycled in! Remember that keys are a thing of the past, so simply open these Chests up in your inventory as soon as they drop!

Full details with previews can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1660013106950104910]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CBtlQAf.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OlpwYbI.gif[/img]

We've overhauled how loot works in Armello. That coin flip, along with Keys are a thing of the past. In addition to this we've implemented free daily Chests, a daily drop counter AND improved Chest transparency.

All of the juicy details can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2793794473564667668]here[/url].


There you have it! We hope you dig the changes and we hope you're excited for the April update, which is only just around the corner. Share the good word on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and we'll talk to you soon!


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: March Update Feature Reveal, Loot Redux.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OlpwYbI.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Greetings one and all![/h1]

Welcome to the fourth and final feature reveal for the March Update. This update in all it's glory will land on the 21st. If you saw, the previous feature reveal was announcing Skeeve's Curiosities and we have another feature extremely relevant to this curious collection.

We've received a bunch of feedback in regards to how we manage our drops, and we're excited that we've been able to improve our transparency along with the experience on your end!

Here are the changes coming to loot in the March Update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4pSH5ox.gif[/img]

[h1]Keyless chests[/h1]
[list][*]From this collection onwards, only Chests will drop and they do [b]not[/b] require a key to open.
[*]Chests are attainable through Private AND Public Multiplayer games from now on.
[*]After Multiplayer Games, you will be granted a Chest up to your daily drop counter.
[*]NO MORE COIN FLIP. We killed the coin. It's dead. Good riddance.
[*]Faster, reliable, guaranteed loot action. As you can just open them by themselves, you earn dice twice as fast.
[*]All previous collections will remain as they were, keys and chests intact.[/list]

[h1]Free daily chest[/h1]
[list][*]Navigate to Skeeve's Shop daily to pick up a Chest on the house!
[*]This Chest doesn't count towards your daily drop counter.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VMUqKmy.png[/img]



[h1]Daily drop counter[/h1]
[list][*]We've always had a daily drop limit, and now it's visible in the Multiplayer lobby.
[*]Daily drop limit revised to 3, down from a previous 6. So essentially the same amount of daily loot.
[*]A timer is visible to display how much time you have before your chest drops replenish.
[/list]

[h1]Chest Transparency[/h1]
[list][*]From Skeeve's Curiosities onwards, the content drop rates relevant to the chest will be openly displayed in Skeeve's Shop.
[*]Please note that these odds do not necessarily apply to previous collections.[/list]


There we have it folks! Hope you're excited about the coming changes and for the March Update in general. Hold tight for the beta to go live and please feel free to hit me with any questions.


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]

EDIT: Added Free Daily Chest details <3
EDIT: Chests are now attainable through Private Multiplayer games too, instead of just Public. <3

notes.title: February Update Re-release, The Road to 2.0 ACTUALLY begins!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VOYPQXm.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]The February Update is live! Make sure your client has been updated and jump in there![/h1]

Hello everyone!

We made it. It was close, but it's still February in some parts of the world - and the Feb update is absolutely live. I really want to extend our appreciation for your patience throughout the rollback and beta. We've refined our processes and analytics and grown from the experience, so it'll be smooth sailing ahead.

Remember that you can expect an update monthly leading up to 2.0 later this year. Naturally the update and feature sizes will vary but we're excited for the journey.

Here's the feature list for the update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OzaFVU6.gif[/img]

We've given the Trickery Deck a little bit of love with two new cards that feature a new card mechanic in Armello, the Merchant system. Roxy has you covered for Followers, and Biff has all the Treasures you need.

Full description of the new cards and the Merchant system [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1662261735520880883]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bGM2sxT.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qhn5zNO.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mrlSIKc.gif[/img]

The King Part One & Two, are now available and the rest will come in time. In order to obtain these, all you have to do is step into Skeeve's store and pick 'em up. Don't worry though, Skeeve is happy to hand these out for free. Once obtained, navigate to your in-game inventory, open one up and allow the beautiful words pour into your mind.

Full description of the Novellas and the in-game reader [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1662262371370501391]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvtfzes.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zL7ey5I.gif[/img]

For 36 hours every Wednesday, Stranger Games will become available - opening an additional multiplayer queue that features a different set of House Rules weekly. This will be an extra queue, so it's purely opt-in. Coin flips and therefore Chests and Keys will drop in this queue too, so you can get your dirty mitts on your loot in a different way now.

This new functionality has been applied to Fury Friday too, so those of you that want to avoid getting furious are now able to!

Full description of Stranger Games [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2912011357794949377]here[/url].


There we have it please feel free to spread the love and the hype either in the comments below or on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] or [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url].


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad

notes.title: Feb Update: Beta Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Bwk0si.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello friends,[/h1]

OKAY so the next hotfix is live on the beta branch and hey, this could break everything or it could fix a lot. Regardless, whichever way it goes we'll learn more and it'll help us power ahead towards an air tight launch. We'll be back in the studio in about 15 hours to find out which way it went.

Really appreciate everyone who's still checking out the beta and doing some testing. Triple drops are still live in the beta branch only so hop in there and grab some sweet, sweet loot.

Here's how to jump into the beta if you'd like to get into the feb update...

[h1]Library > Right click Armello > Properties > Betas > Select "beta" from drop down menu[/h1]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed NMA when Hargrave is hit with Blizzard (Spell Card).
[*]Fixed an NMA that occured rarely on turn start.
[*]Fixed issues related to specific types of card draw, such as Scarlet's Hero Power, Twiss' Hero Power, Conjurer (Follower Card) and a few others.[/list]

[h1]Need More Info[/h1]
[list][*]NMA that can occur at the beginning of a round, specifically when King's Health is altered and/or when guards are about to move.
[/list]

[h1]Other info...[/h1]
[list][*]Please submit your bug reports, and if you're submitting them on the forum or via email please label them with "beta". [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/1471966894865049762/]Here's a thread[/url] on how to report bugs.
[*]This build may be a little buggy but less buggy than the initial release. Strap in, it may or may not be a bumpy ride.
[*]Drops will work in the same way as the live build, except you'll get TRIPLE Drops. The Lunar Dice event is now over on the live AND the beta branch.
[*]Queue times may be a little longer, as this beta is purely an optional opt-in situation.[/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]


EDIT 27/02: Another little update is going live in a few hours that includes a few misc NMA fixes. I didn't want to post a whole other Steam News update about it because we don't have a heap of info to share. Nothin' to see here folks, happy gaming. <3

EDIT: 01/03: The beta is over and the build is on the live branch! Switch back to the main branch using the same method and get in there! Thanks for getting involved! <3

notes.title: Feb Update: Beta Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Bwk0si.gif[/img]

[h1]Howdy![/h1]

The first public hotfix is live on the beta branch, and triple flips are active too! That means that for every coin flip, you'll get three instead. We're going to keep this on for the extent of the beta.

We were hoping to rerelease the Feb update this week and our best minds are on it, but we're not so sure that'll still be the case. As stability comes above all else, we're going to hold it back until the build is air tight. The new estimate is within a week from this post.

Here's how to jump into the beta if you'd like to get into the feb update...

[h1]Library > Right click Armello > Properties > Betas > Select "beta" from drop down menu[/h1]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Multiple NMA's caused by stats from singleplayer being carried over to multiplayer, such as rot persisting between games
[*]Hargrave's hero power now correctly works against Banes and King's Guards
[*]Card draw issue when a player would be AFK during their draw, causing an NMA
[*]Twiss hero power now working as normal
[*]Emissary now properly affecting Terrorised Settlements[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Scout may persist indefinitely
[*]Drawing cards through special means, such as Scarlet's Hero Power, may cause you to draw more than what's normal. Please send us reports on this front!
[/list]

[h1]Other info...[/h1]
[list][*]Please submit your bug reports, and if you're submitting them on the forum or via email please label them with "beta". [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/1471966894865049762/]Here's a thread[/url] on how to report bugs.
[*]This build may be a little buggy but less buggy than the initial release. Strap in, it may or may not be a bumpy ride.
[*]Drops will work in the same way as the live build, except you'll get TRIPLE Drops. The Lunar Dice will still drop too, go get them sweet dice!
[*]Queue times may be a little longer, as this beta is purely an optional opt-in situation.[/list]

Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: February Update: Open Beta is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6Bwk0si.gif[/img]

[h1]Hi![/h1]

Here's something a little different that I'm excited about. The Feb update, as you no doubt have seen, was a little rocky but we're on to smoother waters. The errors that were in that build were extremely ellusive, but the team have been hard at work destroying all that plague our stability.

As of right now, we've opened a beta that you can dive in to, which has all of the new bits and pieces including the novellas and new cards. Here's how you access it...

[h1]Library > Right click Armello > Properties > Betas > Select "beta" from drop down menu[/h1]

OKAY! So please know that this build won't be perfect. It's likely that you'll run into some weirdness, but don't worry, the weirdness will be all ironed out before the public launch. [b]Please submit your bug reports, and if you're submitting them on the forum or via email please label them with "beta".[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/1471966894865049762/]Here's a thread[/url] on how to report bugs.

Here's a brief run down on what you need to know.

[list][*]This build may be a little buggy but less buggy than the initial release. Strap in, it may or may not be a bumpy ride.
[*]Stranger Games will not be active this week unfortunately. If we were to turn it on, it would ruin the live build queues.
[*]Drops will work in the same way as the live build, including Double Drops and the Lunar Dice. Get them sweet dice!
[*]Queue times may be a little longer, as this beta is purely an optional opt-in situation.
[*]Most of the bugs that plagued the initial release are fixed, including the NMA (soft lock) states, King's Guard's Armour, a few hero powers and card targeting issues.
[*]You're all the best, thank you for your patience. The positivity and support through this kerfuffle has been overwhelming and we really appreciate it. [/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

EDIT: Double drops weren't working for the last day or so, so we're in the process of activating triple drops on the beta branch for the next day or so at least. Give 'em hell.

Keep the bug reports flowing, thanks for your vigilance. ❤️

notes.title: The Lunar Dice Event is back online! (Double Flip too!)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/06BZp33.gif[/img]

[h1]A new build is live and the Lunar Dice are dropping once again![/h1]

Howdy community!

The brains have been hard at work and have crafted a v1.9.2 build that includes the Lunar Dice. As such the Lunar New Year revelry may continue! We've extended the event by a few days AND the rest of the event will be a double flip event, meaning DOUBLE the regular loot!

Here are the updated event details:

[b]New Start:[/b] Right now!

[b]End:[/b] February 25th, 10:00am Pacific Time

[b]Game Modes:[/b] Steam, Public Multiplayer (matchmaking necessary)

[b]Please Note:[/b] Coin flips indicate that you have a drop chance. If you exceed your daily coin flip limit, your games will not have a chance of triggering a dice drop.


Thanks for all your patience, folks! 


Much love! 


Trent & the LoG Squad

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/06BZp33.gif[/img]

[h1]A new build is live and the Lunar Dice are dropping once again![/h1]

Howdy community!

The brains have been hard at work and have crafted a v1.9.2 build that includes the Lunar Dice. As such the Lunar New Year revelry may continue! We've extended the event by a few days AND the rest of the event will be a double flip event, meaning DOUBLE the regular loot!

Here are the updated event details:

[b]New Start:[/b] Right now!

[b]End:[/b] February 25th, 10:00am Pacific Time

[b]Game Modes:[/b] Steam, Public Multiplayer (matchmaking necessary)

[b]Please Note:[/b] Coin flips indicate that you have a drop chance. If you exceed your daily coin flip limit, your games will not have a chance of triggering a dice drop.


Thanks for all your patience, folks! 


Much love! 


Trent & the LoG Squad
