notes.title: February Update Rollback to v1.9
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Lisy here, producer at LoG. The highest pillar of our production process here at LoG is stability. Build stability takes precedence and priority over every single decision we make at LoG. 

And, yep! You’re not imagining things, the February update of Armello’s Road to 2.0 is *very* unstable. 

We came in to see this this morning…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fgu9FLt.jpg[/img]

And then, upon further investigation, this... 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oMR8hcY.jpg[/img]

Since releasing the February update we’ve seen a sharp increase of NMA’s (instances when the game does not crash, but “No More Actions” are possible) and Crashes affecting around 16% of games played. This is something we’re taking very seriously and obviously the entire team is truly devastated about it.

With stability being LoG’s highest pillar, we have decided to temporarily roll back Armello to v1.9.2. 

[b]What you need to know (The TL:DR): [/b]
[list]
[*]We have rolled the February update back to v1.9.2 ‘From Below’.
[*]We’ll be working to re-release the February update over the upcoming week. We’ve shifted Karl (lead developer) and Tom (tech director) onto this and only this and QA internal resources will be tripled until the update is out again.
[*]A community testing round will be held when the build is ready.
[*]The Lunar Dice event is currently suspended, but will return within the next 3 days. 
[*]As a result of this, Lunar Dice assets have been removed from the game. [*]They will remain in your inventories and return as soon as the event is live again. 
[*]Upon its return, we will extend the Lunar Dice event to account for any down time (and then some!). 
[*]As a gesture of goodwill, we will also activate double drops for the entirety of the Lunar Dice Event. [/list]

[b]Why did all this happen? [/b]
Okay, so strangely, here’s where the good news is... the February update had some very extensive AI changes hidden in the build. Major AI improvements were to be one of our 2.0 key features that we would announced later this year. Surprise! :/

We’ve been working on the AI overhaul for a while now and the February update was the first build that had these changes merged in.

While these features are not publicly visible or ready to be made “active” in the build, the code was still affected by changes made to support these new features, and apparently waiting to wreak havoc on the live build.  

As part of our release process we have full analytics on test builds, three in-house QA folks manually testing the build, automated testing seeking out errors, crashes and NMAs (by playing four multiplayer games at 10x speed all day and night, non-stop!) before builds are approved for release. We intermittently run community testing, and yes, in hindsight it may have proven valuable for this release. However, time and resources leading up to the release of the February update did not permit us to coordinate this option. 

Additionally, the particular crashes and NMAs occurring in the February update slipped through all above QA measures and realistically, the brute force “testing” provided when the game is live (approx. 10,000 games played per day) is the only thing that would have alerted us to these issues. 

[b]What are we doing to prevent this in future releases: [/b]
[list]
[*]Conduct a post-mortem of our QA and production processes to understand what learnings there are for future releases. 
[*]Analysing each NMA/crash and refining our manual and automated test cases to be able to identify these particular bugs. 
[*]Redesigning our community testing methods to enable a greater diversity of machines, players and network environments, so that we can employ community testing rounds for every release with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.
[*]Armello will never be updated again. (lol, jk. It’s gonna be updated a LOT.) [/list]

Unfortunately, we cannot promise that we will completely eliminate any chance of this happening again. Gamedev is chaotic and Armello is a hyper complex game. BUT what we can promise is that we’ll always respond to these situations as fast as possible, with your best interests in mind, to get you back into Armello with minimal delay.

Thank you all for sending through your bug reports and forum posts, they truly are invaluable and we really appreciate everyone’s patience during this release. We’ll get the February update and Lunar Dice event back online ASAP. Hopefully this transparency into our processes can give you a little insight into our efforts in making this happen. 

If you do have any concerns or questions, feel free to reach out to admin[at]leagueofgeeks.com! We will be posting more information as soon as we’re able to! 

Happy gaming folks! See you in the February update (again, soon!)

<3

Lisy and the LoG Team

notes.title: February Update is Live, The Road to 2.0 begins!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VOYPQXm.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]The February Update is live! Make sure your client has been updated and jump in there![/h1]

Greetings folks!

Here we are. The Road to 2.0 has begun and the Feb update is out and about. If you're the type of person that likes to dig through the patch notes, you can find 'em [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3629.0]here[/url]. I'm going to give you a brief run down of the three primary features of this update.

Remember that you can expect an update monthly leading up to 2.0 later this year. Naturally the update and feature sizes will vary but we're excited for the journey.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OzaFVU6.gif[/img]

We've given the Trickery Deck a little bit of love with two new cards that feature a new card mechanic in Armello, the Merchant system. Roxy has you covered for Followers, and Biff has all the Treasures you need.

Full description of the new cards and the Merchant system [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1662261735520880883]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bGM2sxT.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qhn5zNO.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mrlSIKc.gif[/img]

The King Part One & Two, are now available and the rest will come in time. In order to obtain these, all you have to do is step into Skeeve's store and pick 'em up. Don't worry though, Skeeve is happy to hand these out for free. Once obtained, navigate to your in-game inventory, open one up and allow the beautiful words pour into your mind.

Full description of the Novellas and the in-game reader [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1662262371370501391]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvtfzes.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zL7ey5I.gif[/img]

For 36 hours every Wednesday, Stranger Games will become available - opening an additional multiplayer queue that features a different set of House Rules weekly. This will be an extra queue, so it's purely opt-in. Coin flips and therefore Chests and Keys will drop in this queue too, so you can get your dirty mitts on your loot in a different way now.

This new functionality has been applied to Fury Friday too, so those of you that want to avoid getting furious are now able to!

Full description of Stranger Games [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2912011357794949377]here[/url].


There we have it please feel free to spread the love and the hype either in the comments below or on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] or [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url]. You'll be hearing from us very soon, and the Lunar Dice event begins today too!

Why is everything happening so quickly?


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad

notes.title: The Road to 2.0 - February Feature Reveal, Stranger Games and Split Queues.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zL7ey5I.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates

[h1]Hello![/h1]

The team is preparing to set the new update live, so it's not long now. Here is the third and final primary feature of our February update, Stranger Games. With this addition comes a highly requested feature, split queues.

House Rules are sneaky little additions that fundamentally change Armello's ruleset, and allows us to experiment with wild mechanics. These House Rules only get a spotlight in private games [i]until now[/i].

For 36 hours every Wednesday, Stranger Games will become available - opening an additional multiplayer queue that features a different set of House Rules weekly. This will be an extra queue, so it's purely opt-in. Coin flips and therefore Chests and Keys will drop in this queue too, so you can get your dirty mitts on your loot in a different way now.

This new functionality has been applied to Fury Friday too, so those of you that want to avoid getting furious are now able to!

[b]Start:[/b] 1:00pm Tuesday, Pacific Time
[b]End:[/b] 1:00am Thursday, Pacific Time

The Stranger Games ruleset for this coming Wednesday, the 21st of Feb is as follows:

[h1]Mad King - Deranged[/h1]
The King is deranged and plays more perils to the board than usual.
[h1]Hero Starting Equipment - Treasure and Follower[/h1]
Each player starts with a random Treasure and a random Follower. May the Wyld bless your luck.
[h1]Bane Type - Dire[/h1]
All Banes have extra Fight.
[h1]Dead Player's Paw - On[/h1]
On death, players' hand is discarded.

Make sure you follow us on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] to get the weekly announcements of what the Stranger Games rulesets are, or simply check in-game when the event is live.

As always, hit us with your questions and your hype. We'll see you in Armello.


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: The Road to 2.0 - February Feature Reveal, Novellas.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0b8tlfR.gif[/img]

armello.com/updates/

[h1]Welcome all,[/h1]

Tomorrow is the big day. We'll start down The Road to 2.0, and with this new beginning comes our February update. The second major feature of this update is the Novellas, and the in-game Novella reader.

The King Part One & Two, will be available as of tomorrow and the rest will come in time. All of 'em will all be [b]entirely free[/b]. Over the coming months on The Road to 2.0 we will be releasing each novella one by one, slowly unfolding these fantastical Armello tales before you, our beloved community.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvtfzes.png[/img]


This is by far the most extensive and in-depth exploration of Armello's lore to date. We're really excited for you to finally dive into The King's tale. It's also worth noting that the elegant, lightweight in-game Novella reader is actually a feat within itself. It's sleek, it's smooth, it's beautiful.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z28Hg2s.png[/img]


In order to obtain these, all you have to do is step into Skeeve's store and pick 'em up. Don't worry though, Skeeve is happy to hand these out for free. Once obtained, navigate to your in-game inventory, open one up and allow the beautiful words pour into your mind.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/FFGXud2.png[/img]


Big shout out to the author of these magical tales, [b]Alex Kain[/b]. His patience, creativity and expertise knows no bounds and he is an absolute pleasure to work with. We know you'll love his work.

As always, let me know if you have any questions. Hope you're excited.


[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]


EDIT: Please note that the Novellas will only be available in English due to incredible localisation costs. We are investigating a potential solution, utilizing community driven localisation. More news on this to come. ːspiritstoneː

Let us know what you think and ready yourselves for the next feature reveal.

[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Super Blue Blood Moon Event, January 31st.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/478f541b52f1196c5818f0767ed0401ea44b1d2e.png[/img]

The Super Blue Blood Moon approaches, and Armello will bathe in it's mysterious power. For the first time in Armello history, players will receive [b]three coin flips instead of one[/b] after Public Multiplayer games for 24 hours only.

[b]Event start time:[/b] Midnight, as the clock rolls over to the 31st of January PT. (7:00pm 31/01 AEST)

As far as Armello is concerned, loot will flow freely.

Please be mindful that there is an internal drop limit designed to halt farmers attempting to exploit our Steam Inventory items. If you play a bunch, you may exhaust your drops for the day.

Go with grace and dance under the essence of the blood moon.


[h1]<3 Darcy & LoG[h1]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.9.2 (patch 4)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

[h1]Happy New Year friends![/h1]

Hope you're all well and I hope your batteries are all recharged for a cool new year. We just pushed an update that tends to one important bug that popped up whilst we were away.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Removed bugged player account from the Multiplayer queue.[/list]


This is a really weird one so I'm going to elaborate for those that are interested. A user's Steam account bugged out, leaving essentially a ghost in our multiplayer queue. We couldn't remove them from the queue, because they aren't even in Armello, it's just some series of network messages caught in a loop.

By updating Armello's version, we've essentially left that queue-ghost on a now reduntant version, where it will actually continue to exist indefinitely, as far as we can tell.

This is some bizarre, Black Mirror stuff.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

tags.bug: [*]Removed bugged player account from the Multiplayer queue.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NuY95ZB.gif[/img]

[h1]Yordana (Bear Clan)[/h1]
[b]Hero Power:[/b] Spells cast to Yordana during her turn are devoured in her cauldron for -1 Magic, granting a Curse Spell at the end of her turn.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rWAFNC6.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rbBo02X.gif[/img]

[h1]Griotte (Rat Clan)[/h1]
[b]Hero Power:[/b] Griotte's Clan Affinity Dice Bonus is equal to the number of Trickery Cards played the previous Day.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CdBwntZ.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nber7Qm.gif[/img]

Here's a note to the folks out there that speak Traditional Chinese. <3

所有愛門羅的中文玩家們，你們好！ 

我們榮幸地宣佈，我們剛剛為愛門羅加入了繁體中文選項。在翻譯與測試過程中，我們投入了很多努力，但若還有不足之處，歡迎您隨時在我們的論壇上發表反饋，我們將繼續完善遊戲的本地化。希望您能喜歡，並將這個好消息告知其他人。 

願您的登基之旅好運常伴。


Happy gaming everyone and thank you for an amazing year. This is the last you'll hear from us for a few weeks most likely. Be good and have fun!


[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

P.S. [A hot tip from Trent] If you're looking to purchase the Rivals Hero Pack at launch, I've got a hot tip for you. As you may have guessed, the Rivals Hero Pack will be added to the Armello - Collectors' Edition Bundle. If you have already purchased the bundle, once Rivals is released you can simply purchase the bundle again and score the 10% bundle discount on Rivals too!

notes.title: Rivals Public Beta After Action Report
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/b6d3f4bd15aedf27727bef949db9e8470f906377.png[/img]

Armellians! Hi!

With the release of our latest major DLC just hours away now, I wanted to reach out to you all and share some results from the Rivals Public Beta and what to expect when the DLC ships. 

[h1]First up, some NUMBERS:[/h1][list]
[*]Over 40,000 games of Armello were played in just 48 hours!
[*]Rivals Heroes were played approximately 16,000 times.
[*]Over 100,000 Banes slain. We don't know if in the name of the Wyld or the Rot...?
[*]The King's loyal and ever so cute guards perished over 40,000 times. Not saying you're all uncouth beasts with no respect for the law, I'm just... sayin'.
[*]And... wait for it... almost 1,000,000 cards were played! Ho boy![/list]
Most importantly though, this was not only the most stable DLC release we've rolled out, but the most stable update to Armello possibly ever! The number of critical errors, NMAs and crashes were so low we thought our analytics was busted! 

[h1]What's Next for the Rivals...?[/h1]

As we had predicted, two major points of conversation arose within the community:
[list][*]Fang's starting point of Rot. 
[*]Hargrave firing on King's Guards.[/list]
After reading all the comments and fantastic conversations that went down it became apparent these two caveats surprised some players in a not-so-positive way. To better manager player expectations around Fang and Hargrave's powers we've edited their Hero power descriptions to provide more information and emphasis on the caveats these Heroes possess.

After the beta, we set about the task of collating and combing through the analytics from the Beta and cross-examining that alongside player feedback. The TL;DR is that these Heroes have landed right on target in regards to popularity, win-rate, number of deaths per game, difficulty curve, and other key metrics we measure when assessing and tweaking Hero balance. Fantastically, these Heroes will not only bring Armello's complete roster to 20 Heroes (and fill that long anticipated fourth Clan slot), but have proven to be serious contenders for the throne amongst long standing favourites! 

To that note, the improved Hero Power descriptions will be the extent of the gameplay changes made to Rivals for launch. 

For any of you still have concerns; rest assured, we will be monitoring these Heroes, Rings and Amulets very closely post-release. 

[h1]In Conclusion[/h1]
We're super happy with how the rollout went! Was an epic couple of days and stability, balance, popularity, and engagement all came in super strong! So awesome to see you all fire up for this little experiment of ours. We hope you had as much fun as we did. 

From myself and the rest of the team here at League of Geeks, I'd like to thank all of you for your participation in the Beta. We're definitely penning this one up as a success and a large part of that is thanks to you! 

I also want to pass on an additional and special thank you to our testing community whose feedback and initial couple of passes playing these Heroes helped us immensely in bringing them to you all. Cheers, folks!


[b]<3 Trent & the LoG Crew[/b]

[h1]P.S.[/h1] If you're looking to purchase the Rivals Hero Pack at launch, I've got a hot tip for you. As you may have guessed, the Rivals Hero Pack will be added to the [b]Armello - Collectors' Edition Bundle[/b]. If you have already purchased the bundle, once Rivals is released you can simply purchase the bundle again and score the 10% bundle discount on Rivals too!

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

[h1]Hi there,[/h1]

The Rivals beta event is now over, so the Rivals have retreated from Armello. Hope you all had a great time trying out the new heroes. Massive thank you to everyone that submitted bug reports. Reminder that the Rivals hero pack will go live on the 20th of December so let that hype brew.

Here are a bunch of fixes that we managed to implement in direct result from the bug reports we recieved.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

notes.title: The Rivals beta event is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/b6d3f4bd15aedf27727bef949db9e8470f906377.png[/img]

[h1]COME ONE, COME ALL,[/h1]

The Rivals Beta event is live RIGHT NOW! Make sure Armello is up to date and get in there. Here’s a link to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1464097826806316321]patch notes[/url] if you’d like to see what other changes have folded into this update.

Please be sure to shoot through any feedback you might have in the forums. We're keen to see what you think.

[b]Details of the Rivals Hero Pack Public Beta[/b]
[b]Cost:[/b] Free (requires Armello base game)
[b]Duration:[/b] 48 hours
[b]Begins:[/b] Monday the 11th of December, (3:00pm Pacific Time)
[b]Ends:[/b] Wednesday the 13th (3:00pm Pacific Time)
[b]Playable in:[/b] All game modes. 
[b]Platforms:[/b] Steam (PC/Mac/Linux). 

Note: At the end of the Public Beta the Rivals will become locked once again, awaiting their official launch as paid DLC on Steam on December 20th. Also, yes, the Rivals Hero Pack will be available for purchase on PS4 and Xbox One, just at a later date. Check out the FAQ below for more info.

Happy gaming, friends.


[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]



[h1]If I start a game with one of the Rivals during this event, can I save it and finish it afterwards?[/h1]
No, any save games with the Rivals will be deleted after the event concludes. 

[h1]How do I participate in this event?[/h1]
All you need to do is log in to Armello on Steam during the specified times, 11th December, 3:00pm PT to 13th December 3:00pm PT. You do not need to own any DLC to participate, just the base game.

[h1]Do I get to keep the heroes forever if I log in during these times?[/h1]
No.

This is a trial event. You can play with them as much as you’d like during this event and afterwards they will become locked until their launch as paid DLC on the 20th of December.

[h1]Why are you running this event?[/h1]
Honestly, the only window we had available to release the Rivals was in late December, but our crew also needs to have a holiday - which just so happens to begin two days after Rivals launch on December 20th. 

These heroes have been extensively tested by our external testing community and our in-house quality assurance staff for months, but game development is the wild wild west and anything can happen when you throw thousands of players at new content.

With the introduction of any content comes a certain amount of risk, and we want to assure that we get the best chance to catch any potential problems as early as possible. 

So we figured this is an awesome opportunity to let you, our awesome community, try our new Heroes for free, while also ensuring the build is as stable and solid for the holiday break. 

We’d be happy to answer any questions or concerns you might have about this.


[h1]Why is this Steam only?[/h1]
We have total control over the Steam build and as such can prepare and pivot on builds as fast as we can move, but turning around console and mobile builds require an extensive preparation and submission process. This trial will fortify the build in preparation for it to land across all of our non-Steam platforms too.


[h1]Why are hero packs paid DLC?[/h1]
We’re now in our third year of post launch support for Armello, and we’ve updated the game nine(+) times with significant, free gameplay updates. Check out the history of our updates [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].

Each item of paid content has its own production budget and timelines, as well as revenue targets, with the goal that it will help fund development of the next free update or next paid DLC; And so the cycle continues. Without putting a price tag on our more premium content, which is incredibly costly to develop, we simply would not be able to afford its creation.

DLC helps us make money, allowing us to eat food, get haircuts, and make more cool premium AND free content.

<3

[h1]What’s the most cost-effective way to get these new Heroes?[/h1]
Technically, grinding Chests, Keys, Dice, Skin Fragments and Skins in-game and selling them on the Steam Marketplace to offset the price.

Otherwise, they will be added to the Armello Collector’s Edition bundle. Please note that if you own everything in the bundle in it’s current form, you can actually purchase it THROUGH the bundle once we add the Rivals, applying that sweet sweet bundle discount. Should I say bundle more?

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey folks,[/h1]

Here are the patch notes for v1.9.3 and along with it, the Rivals Beta event is live until 13th of December, 3:00pm (PT). We'll do a seperate announcement about the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1464097826806327791]beta event[/url] in just a moment so head there for all of the details for that.

Please be mindful that with larger changes, like new heroes for example, comes a certain amount of chaos. Be sure to submit bug reports if you encounter any weirdness, and please share your feedback about the new bits and pieces!

[h1]New Heroes (Live December 20th)[/h1]
The four new heroes will be playable by anyone that owns Armello on Steam during the Rivals Beta event, starting now and finishing on the 13th of December, 3:00pm (Pacific Time).
[list][*][b]Fang[/b] (Wolf Clan) Hero Power: When attacking, if Fang Slaughters his opponent, Battle ends before they strike back.
[*][b]Hargrave[/b] (Rabbit Clan) Hero Power: After ending his turn on a Plains, Hargrave will fire his cannon at any creature entering an adjacent tile.
[*][b]Yordana[/b] (Bear Clan) Hero Power: Spells cast to Yordana during her turn are devoured in her cauldron for -1 Magic, granting a Curse Spell at the end of her turn.
[*][b]Griotte[/b] (Rat Clan) Hero Power: Griotte's Clan Affinity Dice Bonus is equal to the number of Trickery Cards played the previous Day.[/list]

[h1]New Ring & Amulets (Live December 20th)[/h1]
[list][*][b]Intimidate[/b] (Amulet): End your turn next to a creature, they suffer -1 Dice until the end of their next turn.
[*][b]Cat's Eye[/b] (Rat Ring): Get a 1 Gold refund on First Trickery Card played each Turn.
[*][b]Spinel[/b] (Rabbit Ring): Get a 10% bonus in all Quest Tests.
[*][b]Chrysocolla[/b] (Wolf Ring): Grants scout on heroes with 2 Health or less
[*][b]Taaffeite[/b] (Bear Ring): +1 Shield in Forests.[/list]

[h1]Card changes[/h1]
[list][*][b]Bane Blade[/b] (Treasure): Effect is now "In Battle, +4 Dice. After each Battle where you don't kill your opponent, -1 Health."
[*][b]Blood Money[/b] (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck. 
[*][b]Expendables[/b] (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck.
[*][b]Incite Revolt[/b] (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck. 
[*][b]Arson[/b] (Trickery): Cost decreased from 3 Prestige to 2.
[*][b]Ranger's Cloak[/b] (Item): Cost decreased from 2 to 1.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed rare bug where the End Turn button would remain on screen (multiplayer only).
[*]Fixed bug where you couldn't customise AI dice skins in singleplayer. 
[*]Fixed bug where Fast Forward animation would not appear on icon when using the direct right thumbstick push on controllers. 
[*]Continue button would overlap prologue chat when a controller is plugged in. 
[*]Fixed bug where turn timer layered over the hero portrait. 
[*]Fixed bug where previewing Quest rewards with controller would cause overlapping.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Amber & Sana's Prologue will NMA if you enter battle with AI. 
[*]Cat's Eye doesn't correctly take Gold.
[*]Griotte will revert to fanning animation in Clan Grounds if she dies at night with her Hero Power active.
[*]Hargrave hunkers down when his turn is forced to end.
[*]AFK timer may not kick AFK players correctly.
[*]Multiplayer banners may not appear in lobbies correctly.
[*]EDIT: Curse of Eye Yordana pact does not visually break correctly on combat. (gameplay effect ends, but pact visuals remain until either player dies)[/list]


THERE YOU HAVE IT FOLKS! Have fun, do some good battle and good luck in your journey for the throne.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jEXHWgg.png[/img]

[h1]HEAR YE, HEAR YE,[/h1]

The [url=https://www.facebook.com/ArmelloGame/videos/1832335840130490/]rumours[/url] are true; we have a brand new pack of Heroes coming VERY soon! 

However, for the first time ever we’ll be running a public beta within Armello, making these new Heroes available for you to try out *for free* ahead of their release on Steam. 

Who are these mysterious heroes you say? You will find out soon enough. They will make themselves known and mark my words, you will not forget them.

[b]Details of the Rivals Hero Pack Public Beta[/b]
[b]Cost:[/b] Free (requires Armello base game)
[b]Duration:[/b] 48 hours
[b]Begins:[/b] Monday the 11th of December, (3:00pm Pacific Time)
[b]Ends:[/b] Wednesday the 13th (3:00pm Pacific Time)
[b]Playable in:[/b] All game modes. 
[b]Platforms:[/b] Steam (PC/Mac/Linux). 

Note: At the end of the Public Beta the Rivals will become locked once again, awaiting their official launch as paid DLC on Steam on December 20th. Also, yes, the Rivals Hero Pack will be available for purchase on PS4 and Xbox One, just at a later date. Check out the FAQ below for more info.

Keep a close eye on our [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] for Hero reveals leading up to the event, and their release. 

See you on the battlefield, adventurers.


[h1]<3 Darcy, Trent & the LoG Squad[/h1]





[h1]How do I participate in this event?[/h1]
All you need to do is log in to Armello on Steam during the specified times, 11th December, 3:00pm PT to 13th December 3:00pm PT. You do not need to own any DLC to participate, just the base game.

[h1]Do I get to keep the heroes forever if I log in during these times?[/h1]
No.

This is a trial event. You can play with them as much as you’d like during this event and afterwards they will become locked until their launch as paid DLC on the 20th of December.

[h1]Why are you running this event?[/h1]
Honestly, the only window we had available to release the Rivals was in late December, but our crew also needs to have a holiday - which just so happens to begin two days after Rivals launch on December 20th. 

These heroes have been extensively tested by our external testing community and our in-house quality assurance staff for months, but game development is the wild wild west and anything can happen when you throw thousands of players at new content.

With the introduction of any content comes a certain amount of risk, and we want to assure that we get the best chance to catch any potential problems as early as possible. 

So we figured this is an awesome opportunity to let you, our awesome community, try our new Heroes for free, while also ensuring the build is as stable and solid for the holiday break. 

We’d be happy to answer any questions or concerns you might have about this.


[h1]Why is this Steam only?[/h1]
We have total control over the Steam build and as such can prepare and pivot on builds as fast as we can move, but turning around console and mobile builds require an extensive preparation and submission process. This trial will fortify the build in preparation for it to land across all of our non-Steam platforms too.


[h1]Why are hero packs paid DLC?[/h1]
We’re now in our third year of post launch support for Armello, and we’ve updated the game nine(+) times with significant, free gameplay updates. Check out the history of our updates [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].

Each item of paid content has its own production budget and timelines, as well as revenue targets, with the goal that it will help fund development of the next free update or next paid DLC; And so the cycle continues. Without putting a price tag on our more premium content, which is incredibly costly to develop, we simply would not be able to afford its creation.

DLC helps us make money, allowing us to eat food, get haircuts, and make more cool premium AND free content.

<3

[h1]What’s the most cost-effective way to get these new Heroes?[/h1]
Technically, grinding Chests, Keys, Dice, Skin Fragments and Skins in-game and selling them on the Steam Marketplace to offset the price.

Otherwise, they will be added to the Armello Collector’s Edition bundle. Please note that if you own everything in the bundle in it’s current form, you can actually purchase it THROUGH the bundle once we add the Rivals, applying that sweet sweet bundle discount. Should I say bundle more?

notes.title: Hotfix v1.9.1 (patch 6), & Dev Insights
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey all,[/h1]

Here's another patch straight from the patch farm. It has grown in to a strong beast and now is ready for the public. Just below, we're going to address recent confusion/concerns about patch size and content relevant to other platforms sneaking in to the build.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Rings and Amulets now available to play in Offline mode
[*]Ring and Amulet progression are now working in Offline mode
[*]Fixed transmogrify is now work for Collection 1
[*]Fixed rare UI glitch of Skeeve's store showing incorrect[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Rare NMA on AFK player only when trying to disconnect from game.[/list]

[h1]Patch Size[/h1]
We're aware that these smaller hotfixes are coming through as larger downloads. I believe this one was over 700mb and we totally understand that this is not ideal. We're going to keep an eye on the size and frequency of those bad boys to ensure Armello remains accessible to folks all around the world in all different internet conditions. Thank you for your patience on this front.

[h1]Other platform content got up in the build(soft currency)[/h1]
Armello is a complex beast that's on multiple platforms and Unity is our engine of choice. All of our features and code are tossed into one master build and when we make a build ready to go live we chose the platform we're publishing to and Unity SHOULD package it up with the platform specific features only available. Sometimes platform specific stuff slips through like Xbox One controller icons and more recently, iOS specific soft currency UI. 

For those don't know iOS is currently in soft-launch in Australia and New Zealand only while we test out the pricing models as well as stabilising the build. The mobile market is completely different to Steam and we're approaching them with that consideration in mind.

There have been a bunch of conversations online lately about monetisation and lootboxes, and due to this I think folks were concerned to see references to in-game currency in Armello, which is strictly an iOS feature. I want to be clear in saying we don't have plans to integrate this into Armello.

For the sake of transparency, I want to take this opportunity to invite any curious minds out there to check out the iOS beta and judge it on it's own merits. Click the link below to sign up and it'd be much appreciated if you took your time to share your thoughts! The gist of the first review we got was "the drops are so generous, LoG probably won't make any money" which is nice... I think?

http://www.armello.com/iosbeta


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Armello's 5th Collection, Rites of Ruin, Emerges October 4th, PT
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3zabZJ8.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings friends,[/h1]

It's been some time since we launched the previous Collection, Druid's Bequest, and we're just about ready to plunge into corruption. From the [b]4th of October (Pacific Time)[/b], the mysterious [b]Rites of Ruin[/b] collection will crawl into Armello and [b]Dire Chests and Dire Keys[/b] will be awarded to players who complete multiplayer games.

You have one week to get your dirty mitts on Druid Chests and Druid Keys in-game, and then they will be consumed by the abyss. Keep a close eye on our [url=Facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] for spoilers leading up to the date.


May the coin flip in your favour,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

EDIT: We hate to do this, but unfortunately v1.9.1 and the Rites of Ruin collection has been delayed until tomorrow, the 5th of October PT. It will land in the afternoon if all goes according to plan.

We've had a last minute game breaking bug pop up, causing the latest build candidate to be unsafe to push into your hands. As I understand it, there is an issue with the dice skins which is causing games to freak out and NMA.

We'll keep you in the loop and fix this bad boy up for you quick-smart. Thanks again for your vigilance and patience. Please hit me up if you have any questions.

notes.title: Fury Mode - Now a WEEKLY event!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MCiSO5v.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello dearest Armellians,[/h1]

It's happening. We're ready to commit to Fury Friday as a weekly event and I hope that you're as happy (& furious) as we are.

[h1]FURY FRIDAY![/h1]
As always, it'll be longer than 24 hours to hit as many Fridays as we can around the world. [b]It will begin roughly 2:00pm Thursday PT and it will conclude at roughly 2:00am on Saturday PT[/b].

When Fury Friday is active, games started through Public Multiplayer will have the [b]Fury Mode House Rule active and the King will have one less health[/b]. This will mean quick, action packed Armello experiences to mix things up in the multiplayer queue.

Here are the key elements of Fury Mode
[h1][list][*]Very short turn times
[*]Turn timer pauses in combat and perils
[*]Burndown timer reduced in combat and perils
[*]A short card draw timer applies per card
[*]Questing / Hidden encounter timer is no longer independent, and instead adds time to your current turn timer
[*]Shortened King’s Declaration timer
[*]Shortened transitional sequences and AI animations 
[*]Instead of resetting the timer, taking actions grants seconds to your current turn.
[*]Visualisation implemented for turn timer adjustments
[*]Timer is visible at all times[/list][/h1]

There's a little FAQ (excuse the semi-copypasta) below because I just know you've got questions.

Happy gaming!

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]



[h1]"More like FURRY MODE lol"[/h1]
Haha okay friend we know, we know. <3 :spiritstone:

[h1]"Does Fury Friday happen every Friday?"[/h1]
From now on, yes, it will. GET EXCITED!

[h1]"I don't like Fury Mode, what do I do on Fridays?!"[/h1]
That's a bummer and I'm sorry to hear that. Everyone has their preference and, I hope you at least try it once or twice but I'm not going to tell you how to live your life. You can still play classic Armello in singleplayer and private multiplayer if your heart so desires. Otherwise, here's a few other activities you can do during this time:
[list][*]Find a cardboard box and duct tape. Use it to craft armour and challenge a friend to friendly duel.
[*]Do a real-life trickery play and tell a friend that a mutual friend of yours was talking smack about them behind their back. There's no better way to assert your dominance.
[*]Bake a chocolate caramel cheesecake (obviously, the closest real-life action to casting a spell).[/list]

Jokes aside, it would be silly for us to assume that 100% of players want it this way. We are completely convinced, however, that this offers a variety in gameplay that ultimately provides more satisfying options to more players. We're going to keep working on creating more variety in Armello's future.

[h1]"Can you please create two queues so that it's optional"[/h1]
We're always looking for ways to make the most amount of people happy. Happy gamers means happy developers. Maybe one day we'll be able to implement another queue, but our current infrastructure supports one so this is how things will be until further notice. They call me Darcy, not "Two Queue Tony", okay.

[h1]"When will this event begin and when will it end?"[/h1]
As said above, it will begin roughly 2:00pm Thursday PDT and it will conclude at roughly 2:00am on Saturday PDT. If you're not in the PDT timezone then all is lost and life is chaos (or use a cool widgetty thing [url=https://www.worldtimebuddy.com/]like this[/url] to convert the time for you).

Also, I say roughly because we are merely meat creatures on a rock floating through existence, and anything can happen. Someone might delay us with a cardboard armour duel or something idk.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.9 (Patch 5)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

[h1]Hi there![/h1]

What's poppin'? Hope you're all having a lovely week. Naturally the codery have been plugging away at fixes and some of them have been declared safe enough to launch into the live build, so here you have it.

If you have been submitting bug reports, you are powerful and brave. You're the best.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Rare NMA fix for when a player died after Combat during the death fade out.
[*]Fixed NMA during Fury Mode when entering Combat on 0 time remaining.
[*]Rare fixed NMA when burning cards after the Dice roll.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]If you play a singleplayer game in Dutch and go to continue the saved game; it can NMA. If you switch to English this will resolve the issue after restarting Armello.
[*]The volume of some sounds isn't being modified by the volume sliders, such as the Rot Vines growing from the Palace.
[*]If you have a saved Singleplayer game that saved when the King's health was 0, continuing it will result in an NMA. If you clear the save game by starting a new Singleplayer, Armello will resolve.
[/list]

Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

That's a bummer, I hope you at least try it once or twice but I'm not going to tell you how to live your life. You can still play classic Armello in singleplayer and private multiplayer if your heart so desires. Otherwise, here's a few other activities you can do during this time:
[list][*]Find a cardboard box and duct tape. Use it to craft armour and challenge a friend to friendly duel.
[*]Do a real-life trickery play and tell a friend that a mutual friend of yours was talking smack about them behind their back. There's no better way to assert your dominance.
[*]Bake a chocolate caramel cheesecake (obviously, the closest real-life action to casting a spell).[/list]

[h1]"Can you please create two queues so that it's optional"[/h1]
Maybe one day, but our current infrastructure supports one so that's how things will be until further notice. My name is Darcy, not "Two Queue Terry", okay.

[h1]"When will this event begin and when will it end?"[/h1]
As said above, it will begin roughly 2:00pm Thursday PDT and it will conclude at roughly 2:00am on Saturday PDT. If you're not in the PDT timezone then all is lost and life is chaos (or use a cool widgetty thing [url=https://www.worldtimebuddy.com/]like this[/url] to convert the time for you).

Also, I say roughly because we are merely meat creatures on a rock floating through existence, and anything can happen. Someone might challenge us to a cardboard armour duel or something idk.

[h1]"This whole FAQ is weird and I'm uncomfortable."[/h1]
Listen I'm just trying to spread my wings over here, let me get weird with it.

notes.title: The Anniversary Event is Live! - Pride's Destiny Dice
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FsupElsiZxI1N9S/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

As mentioned the other day, we're celebrating Armello's second birthday, and the celebrations have begun!

[h1]From now until Thursday the 7th (PDT), after completing Public Multiplayer games you will have a small chance to receive the Pride's Destiny dice.[/h1]

Once again, important things to note:
[list][*]You can obtain multiple sets of these if you're lucky (even if you already have them). Sell your extras on the Steam marketplace or gift them to an ally. <3
[*]You are not guaranteed to receive these dice. They are [b]rare[/b].
[*]Pride's Destiny visually scale in-game relevant to your Hero's Rot.
[*]There is an internal drop limit in Armello to stop exploiters/farmers/botters. If you play a lot and stop receiving coin flips, you have likely hit this limit. Fear not, this refreshes daily.[/list]

Good luck in your games and be sure to show off the dice you find.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif[/img]

Greetings everyone!

As you definitely know by now, v1.9 From Below dropped on Steam and it's packed with juicy new features. Make sure that Armello is all up to date and get in there!

I'll run through the major elements of this update, but if you're a human that prefers to wade through the nuts and bolts of it all, you can check the patch notes out [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3364.0]here[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/P0WRgz3.gif[/img]

For completing each episode of the introductory prologue, a new sets of Clan Dice will be awarded, resulting in a total of four - one for each clan! For players that have completed this, the skins will be automatically awarded when you log in!

Read all about it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1435940000441454534]here[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/379/86b5ca1d87e8f7ba4fa8537b59591288_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503470537&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5dc603aa72156139f9248bfded107bbe[/img]

We’ve been refining Fury Mode as a House Rule since the launch of it in v1.8 and we're finally prepared to give it the love it deserves. When Fury Friday is active, games started through Public Multiplayer will have the Fury Mode House Rule active and the King will have one less health. This will mean quick, action packed Armello experiences to mix things up in the multiplayer queue.

More details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2523559405393158273?tscn=1502954527]here[/url]!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/382/24442e45e4ce2929ca34a06eab9b9a33_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503470570&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=58d9080c2e7c3b7b0ac38d174dcf1e11[/img]

You will now be able to hit a maximum level of 100! As such, four new glorious frames have been implemented to convey your success in the multiplayer environment. Get in there, play some games and uncover some new frames!

A preview of these frames can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2523559405397499857]here[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/386/5f48b3f0d5a165faa5b469e530cc6c4b_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503470613&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9647cbcb07220b53712b66de3c291b2a[/img]

In v1.8, The King got a lot of love in regard to his animations and textures, detailing his descent into madness as the game progresses. Now, the world will plunge into darkness with him.

Throughout the duration of the game, the following effects will be introduced.

[list][*]Palace texture will progressively degrade
[*]Rot vines will progressively creep outward from the palace
[*]Ravens will amass above the palace over time
[*]A dark storm will brew above the palace over time[/list]

Full details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2523559405409442072]here[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/387/c037c05523d2b34d4d4f740f1a60060b_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503470641&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=71f1a596eb33b82fc4c21795edd7dc3e[/img]

Experienced adventurers are well aware that Banes spawn from dungeons at night. Now, during the day certain dungeons will indicate that a Bane will emerge the following evening. This will impact the decisions you make when traversing the twisting lands of Armello.

Read all about it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2523559405412840607]here[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/396/29dd9db9f47058393633ef71b5912aec_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503470697&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ee2826393c5a03c00b47694df2653914[/img]

Three glorious new cards have come to Armello. They are all Spell cards and two of 'em are Rot related.

Check the original post here.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/597/21cfe4f10abe6916613aea1477f90190_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503472195&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f833777ecd6e453a851cc55d3a2a45fd[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/599/b328dd21277ac800678e246e0bb9c80a_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503472215&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=05b868babd9ebab765ad673687c27994[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/030/601/bbdfed5972ea64f5b332146413daedac_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1503472233&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b8725b4cf9e206585e4a27a25f168c72[/img]

That's pretty much a wrap! As always please feel free to reach out if you have any questions!


Cheers,


[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below Feature Reveal - New Cards
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/GBKV9KW.gif[/img]

[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.9 From Below. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]


[h1]Howdy everyone![/h1]

This is the sixth and final feature reveal of v1.9 From Below, new cards. Three new cards are coming to Armello, two of which are Rot related. To give a little bit of an insight into the art of Syphon, which is also the key art for v1.9, is League of Geeks co-founder, director and art director, Ty Carey.

[quote=Ty Carey]With Syphon I wanted to go full metal/epic - it's a powerful rot spell! It had to be very dramatic to do the card justice, and what better way than a classic stormy, cliff-side summoning? A number of different artists helped out on it - Adam sketched out the Sorcerer-Rat's pose, I rendered it all up and Jack finally animated it, adding some nice touches like the rain. What was important to me was getting those great columns of rot-stuff swirling powerfully through the air, and the vastness of the space they're travelling through.

Collabs like this bear great fruits (perhaps in this case rotten-fruits?).[/quote]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MlD5u9f.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BYpyWTK.gif[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nQiJj0w.gif[/img]

That's a wrap for feature reveals for v1.9! Naturally there will be a bunch of bits and pieces that aren't relevant to the main changes, such as a nice little bump for Hand Cannons and Longbow, for example.


We're hope you're as excited as we are.

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below Feature Reveal - Bane Telegraphing
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jnw6x6d.gif[/img]

[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.9 From Below. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]


[h1]Hello travellers![/h1]

Welcome to the fifth feature reveal for Armello’s big new update, v1.9 From Below. Today we are talking about Bane Telegraphing.

Experienced adventurers are well aware that Banes spawn from dungeons at night. Now, during the day certain dungeons will indicate that a Bane will emerge the following evening. This will impact the decisions you make when traversing the twisting lands of Armello. To talk about this a little more, we have League of Geeks co-founder and director Blake Mizzi.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1EmqrLh.gif[/img]

[quote=Blake Mizzi]We all like to wonder what’s in those deep dark fortified dungeons to the abyss, what horrors they hold back and terrors have been unleashed in their confines – Too many heroes have been surprised and ravaged by a Bane spawn at night, though they are random, there is a logical pattern and system to their apparent madness.

Bane Telegraphing is a new feature we’ve implemented in the new update V1.9 ‘From Below’, we’ve added an indicator in the form of rising, bellowing Rot smog to ‘telegraph’ a Bane’s pending arrival. Players can make great use of this knowledge; They can move to protect a nearby settlement; Or not proceed to a Settlement at all and save their action points; Plan their journey to not come face-to-face with a Bane; Or specifically hunt these creatures out to claim their Prestige. Principally players now have a little more knowledge to make decisions about how to proceed with the threats ahead, and that knowledge is a wonderful thing in the grim kingdom of Armello.[/quote]

Hit us up if you have any questions and please discuss below!

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below Feature Reveal - Ramping Atmosphere
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/J32GRwy.gif[/img]

[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.9 From Below. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]


[h1]Howdy folks![/h1]

Here’s the fourth feature reveal for the upcoming update, v1.9 From Below. Today we’ll be talking about Ramping Atmosphere.

In v1.8, The King got a lot of love in regard to his animations and textures, detailing his descent into madness as the game progresses. Now, the world will plunge into darkness with him. To talk more about this, here’s League of Geeks co-founder and director, Trent Kusters.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ybe38UX.gif[/img]

[quote=Trent Kusters]Something that we’ve always admired here at LoG is how masterful directors balance a contrast between light and dark and in the process craft truly magical worlds that retain a sense of consequence. They know when to take you down into the depths of their work’s conflict and when to let you back up for air. Duality and contrast has been a major theme of Armello since day one. Wyld, Rot. Day, Night. Etc, etc.

However, even through our exploration of this, we’ve always felt that as games of Armello moved forward, the board’s atmosphere never truly reflected the King’s decline and the stakes our Heroes, and the denizens of Armello, faced. We’ve addressed this in our latest update, From Below.

In From Below we’ve introduced a number of effects that will layer upon and around the Palace to reflect the King’s decline into madness and the growing presence of the Rot.

Similar to Zelda: Breath of the Wild, and furthering our attentive balancing of dark and light, these changes will be localised to the centre of the board only. Thus ensuring that your adventures through Armello remain magical, whilst reflecting the reality of the situation.

As the King’s Rot grows, you’ll see Rot Vines grow from the centre of the Palace, ravens will encircle the Palace in greater numbers, and the Palace itself will decay. As the King reaches the final throes of his madness dark storm clouds will appear. An omen of Armello’s end.
[/quote]

Throughout the duration of the game, the following effects will be introduced.
[h1][list][*]Palace texture will progressively degrade
[*]Rot vines will progressively creep outward from the palace
[*]Ravens will amass above the palace over time
[*]A dark storm will brew above the palace over time[/list][/h1]

As always, please hit us up if you have any questions and please feel free to discuss below!

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below Feature Reveal - Fury Friday
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZiXYHr4.gif[/img]

[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.9 From Below. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]

[h1]Greetings![/h1]
 
Here is the second feature reveal for v1.9 From Below, Fury Fridays! As you know, we’ve been refining [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1333478037122987396]Fury Mode[/url] as a House Rule since the launch of it in v1.8 and we think that it’s in a really great place. The feedback has been really positive, so to give it the celebration it deserves, we’ve developed a recurring event that will happen fairly regularly called Fury Fridays.

When Fury Friday is active, games started through Public Multiplayer will have the [b]Fury Mode House Rule active and the King will have one less health[/b]. This will mean quick, action packed Armello experiences to mix things up in the multiplayer queue.

Here are the key elements of Fury Mode
[h1][list][*]Very short turn times
[*]Turn timer pauses in combat and perils
[*]Burndown timer reduced in combat and perils
[*]A short card draw timer applies per card
[*]Questing / Hidden encounter timer is no longer independent, and instead adds time to your current turn timer
[*]Shortened King’s Declaration timer
[*]Shortened transitional sequences and AI animations 
[*]Instead of resetting the timer, taking actions grants seconds to your current turn.
[*]Visualisation implemented for turn timer adjustments
[*]Timer is visible at all times[/list][/h1]

Coin flips will occur as per normal after completed games, but quicker games means quicker loot so the dice enthusiasts out there should be excited too. Also, the implementation of this system opens the door for some other [b]“Strange Rules”[/b]. It may serve beneficial to keep your eyes open for some other odd events...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/f6v99Wn.png[/img]

[h1]The first Fury Friday will take place on the 25th of August PT, and will likely run longer than 24 hours to catch as many time zones as possible![/h1]


Please let me know if you have any questions!

Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.9 From Below Feature Reveal - Clan Dice
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/P0WRgz3.gif[/img]

[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.9 From Below. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]
 
[h1]Welcome Armello family![/h1]
 
Here we have the first feature of v1.9 From Below, Clan Dice! We’re starting with a quaint feature first just to warm up. From now onwards, completing each episode of the Prologue will reward you with the relevant Clan dice. As such, [b]there are a set for each of the Great Clans of Armello; Bear, Rat, Wolf and Rabbit.[/b]

For new players, this means they are rewarded for their valiant efforts in the prologue, introducing them to rewards they can expect to earn in online play. Additionally, with the introduction of Clan Dice new players and offline players get access to an additional flare of customizability. Please note that even though these are Clan Dice, any hero can use any dice, so Mercurio could use the Wolf Clan Dice if he so chooses (traitorous rat…).

For our dear Armello players who are experienced far beyond the likes of our prologue, this means you will be granted four new dice skins immediately on the launch of v1.9. Skins for all!

These won’t be the only dice to come out alongside v1.9, as Skeeve has “obtained” some Premium Dice from each of the clans that will be hitting the store alongside the Rot and Royal dice.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.8.1 (Patch 3 & 4)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YcnPGiO.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey all![/h1]

Here are some details of two patches that landed, one was a few days ago and the other just now. As always, a huge thank you to the glorious humans that took the time to send detailed bug reports.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where initiating combat/quests/dungeons in the very last seconds of your turn could cause an NMA
[*]Fix for a rare NMA when selecting your quest while a Kings Declaration is taking place
[*]Fix for instances of incorrect word wrapping in Simplified Chinese
[*]Fix for a rare NMA during Sargon's card draw.
[*]Fix fora rare issue where two instances of the same hero would appear in game
[*]Fix for a rare issue where a player's turn timer would become infinite.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There may be an issue when attempting to start a Single Player game offline. Please submit bug reports if you encounter this!
[/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Update v1.8.1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YcnPGiO.gif[/img]

[h1]Welcome![/h1]

We've got an update for you today that has some features and some fixes to bathe in! Here are the juicy details.

[h1]King Voice[/h1]
[list][*]The King has brand new end game voice over relevant to victory type (Combat, Prestige, Rot and Spirit Stones)[/list]
[h1]Combat Audio[/h1]
[list][*]New and revised combat audio including blocks, hits, special dice and more.[/list]

[h1]Simplified Chinese Localisation Rework[/h1]
[list][*]We've taken your feedback and completely overhauled the Simple Chinese translation. Let us know what you think![/list]

[h1]Fury Mode Tweaks[/h1]
Thanks to all those who have provided feedback on Fury Mode! We've listened and done a big pass that make it feel a little better overall. Please don't hesitate to hit us up if you have further thoughts/comments.
[list][*]Fury Mode is now listed as it’s own option in House Rules and will override selected Turn timer options
[*]Card select time is 1 second longer
[*]Moving bonus time has been increased from +2 seconds to +3 seconds
[*]Card select time bonus has been increased by +1 second per card (4 seconds per card now)
[*]When a player's turn timer is paused(such as when they are in a quest) it will appear as grey
[*]Timers are paused for an additional second when a player is exiting Battles and Perils.
[*]Equipping items and followers is a now a smoother and quicker process
[*]Equipping over previously equipped items is now smoother and faster.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]End turn button is now working correctly for those players with touch screens
[*]Players who have “{ }” in their Steam names will no longer experience difficulty getting into Multiplayer games.
[/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy @ the LoG Squad[/h1]

EDIT: We're aware of a Ring/Amulet progression bug and we're working hard on a fix,
 more details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/0/1458455461477096739/]here[/url].

EDIT 2: This issue has been resolved. <3

[h1]Hi there![/h1]

A huge fix just went live for a number of visual issues that popped up in v1.8. Check out the full list of things here!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a visual glitch when opening the last Chest of a particular type.
[*]Horace’s Black Company skin can now correctly be selected.

[*]The Rot tutorial can no longer be skipped in Sana's prologue.
[*]Particles now don't clip across an invisible seam on the Combat Screen.
[*]Two King’s Guards can no longer spawn on one tile.
[*]Chat Icon no longer cut off in certain resolutions.
[*]Multiplayer Game prompt dialogue now appears correctly in Singleplayer. 
[*]Changing languages in-game now resolves smoothly.
[*]Fixed an issue with palace transparency and tiltshift. 
[*]Skeeve Store tabs text is correctly localised.
[*]Fog levels reduced.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*](Mac) 3D previews not showing in Skeeve’s store and Steam Inventory.
[*]Kings Guards may break during Prologue.
[*]Hare's Halberd visualises twice in combat.
[*]King roars a little too loud.[/list]


There you have it! Another red hot hotfix out the door. The next one is probably just around the corner!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.8 Shattered Kingdom is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YcnPGiO.gif[/img]

[i]This is the announcement post for the Armello update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]
 
[h1]Greetings all![/h1]
 
It’s a glorious day, as v1.8 Shattered Kingdom has emerged in Armello! Jump in RIGHT NOW! What are you waiting for?!

If you’re the type of human that wants all of the details, please feel free to check the full patch notes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3244.0]here[/url]. Along with the primary features that you can peruse below, we’ve done a lot of audio work and just generally tightened screws all over the place. We really hope you dig it.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vsjvgAe.gif[/img]
 
The King has received some [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2767873904703783881]serious pampering[/url] with all of the trimmings like tantalising animations, delicious audio and sweet, sweet particle effects.
 
[list][*]New Animations and Treatment for Endgame Victory Sequences: Spirit Stone, Rot and Prestige.
[*]New Dusk and Dawn animations.
[*]Updated animations and textures that demonstrate the King's degeneration in-game 
[*]Updated Combat Defence animation[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xuJJqs0.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/i2T9irp.gif[/img]
 
Here we have some [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2767873904707956421]new cards[/url]! [b]King’s Guard Armour[/b] favours characters with larger dice stacks and assists heroes in taking control of their fate, allowing a more reliable spread of useful rolls.
 
If you’re wondering, yes, like the Hare's Halberd all King’s Guards have this item equipped, and it will exist in the deck. This is an overall buff for King’s Guards, improving their defenses and further fortifying their role as blockers on the map.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/p0HlRpi.gif[/img]
 
[b]Reaper’s Trident[/b] is a powerful Treasure that leverages Poison Dice in a big way. Pair this with other items that lock in Swords to cause the Poison Dice to resolve later, hopefully bypassing your opponent's shields.
 
 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7FAq6Ij.gif[/img]
 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1333478037122987396]Fury Mode[/url] is a fast paced, intense version of Armello available in House Rules. It’s less about carefully analysing the board for the most optimal play, and more about following your gut and taking action.
 
 
[h1]And a Few Extras...[/h1]
 
As mentioned earlier, you’ll definitely note some audio love has been put into this update. Additionally, we have a fun little thing that some of you might like to play around with, you can now customise your “Classic Dice”. This will only work for your client and won’t be visible for your opponents.

Within the launch options for Armello in Steam, add the following lines to link to your own Dice textures and normal maps. Image file types that are accepted are PNG and JPEG. You can find some resources attached to [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3258.msg21668#msg21668]this thread[/url] on our own forums.

[h1]-diceTexture "path" 
-diceNormal "path"[/h1]
 
Path example: "C:\Users\WordSlice\Pictures\MyCustomDiceTexture.jpg"

Please share your custom dice with us over on [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url]!


There you have it folks. Thanks for being a part of our incredible community, no doubt the next bit of exciting news is just around the corner!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.8 Shattered Kingdom is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YcnPGiO.gif[/img]

[i]This is the announcement post for the Armello update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]
 
[h1]Greetings all![/h1]
 
It’s a glorious day, as v1.8 Shattered Kingdom has emerged in Armello! Jump in RIGHT NOW! What are you waiting for?!

If you’re the type of human that wants all of the details, please feel free to check the full patch notes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3244.0]here[/url]. Along with the primary features that you can peruse below, we’ve done a lot of audio work and just generally tightened screws all over the place. We really hope you dig it.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vsjvgAe.gif[/img]
 
The King has received some [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2767873904703783881]serious pampering[/url] with all of the trimmings like tantalising animations, delicious audio and sweet, sweet particle effects.
 
[list][*]New Animations and Treatment for Endgame Victory Sequences: Spirit Stone, Rot and Prestige.
[*]New Dusk and Dawn animations.
[*]Updated animations and textures that demonstrate the King's degeneration in-game 
[*]Updated Combat Defence animation[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xuJJqs0.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/i2T9irp.gif[/img]
 
Here we have some [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/2767873904707956421]new cards[/url]! [b]King’s Guard Armour[/b] favours characters with larger dice stacks and assists heroes in taking control of their fate, allowing a more reliable spread of useful rolls.
 
If you’re wondering, yes, like the Hare's Halberd all King’s Guards have this item equipped, and it will exist in the deck. This is an overall buff for King’s Guards, improving their defenses and further fortifying their role as blockers on the map.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/p0HlRpi.gif[/img]
 
[b]Reaper’s Trident[/b] is a powerful Treasure that leverages Poison Dice in a big way. Pair this with other items that lock in Swords to cause the Poison Dice to resolve later, hopefully bypassing your opponent's shields.
 
 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7FAq6Ij.gif[/img]
 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/290340/announcements/detail/1333478037122987396]Fury Mode[/url] is a fast paced, intense version of Armello available in House Rules. It’s less about carefully analysing the board for the most optimal play, and more about following your gut and taking action.
 
 
[h1]And a Few Extras...[/h1]
 
As mentioned earlier, you’ll definitely note some audio love has been put into this update. Additionally, we have a fun little thing that some of you might like to play around with, you can now customise your “Classic Dice”. This will only work for your client and won’t be visible for your opponents.

Within the launch options for Armello in Steam, add the following lines to link to your own Dice textures and normal maps. Image file types that are accepted are PNG and JPEG. You can find some resources attached to [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3258.msg21668#msg21668]this thread[/url] on our own forums.

[h1]-diceTexture "path" 
-diceNormal "path"[/h1]
 
Path example: "C:\Users\WordSlice\Pictures\MyCustomDiceTexture.jpg"

Please share your custom dice with us over on [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url]!


There you have it folks. Thanks for being a part of our incredible community, no doubt the next bit of exciting news is just around the corner!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.8 Shattered Kingdom Feature Reveal - Fury Mode
notes.content:
[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7FAq6Ij.gif[/img]
 
[h1]Welcome folks![/h1]
 
Here we are, at the third and final feature reveal for v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. Today we’re going to talk about an important new House Rule, Fury Mode. Here are the larger elements of this enormous house rule.

[h1][list][*]Very short turn times
[*]Turn timer pauses in combat and perils
[*]Burndown timer reduced in combat and perils
[*]A short card draw timer applies per card
[*]Questing / Hidden encounter timer is no longer independent, and instead adds time to your current turn timer
[*]Shortened King’s Declaration timer
[*]Shortened transitional sequences and AI animations 
[*]Instead of resetting the timer, taking actions grants seconds to your current turn.
[*]Visualisation implemented for turn timer adjustments
[*]Timer is visible at all times[/list][/h1]
 
Fury mode will be a fast paced, intense version of Armello. It’s less about carefully analysing the board for the most optimal play, and more about following your gut and taking action. We’ve found that players are pushed to more effectively utilize their off turns for card play and planning.
 
As you know, we’re working towards releasing Armello on tablets later this year, and it’s possible that Fury Mode will be the primary way to play multiplayer on tablets. This is merely the first iteration and we know there will be room for fine tuning. We’d really love you to take it for a spin and share your thoughts with us! How would you feel if this was the standard way to play Armello?

There you have it, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom is landing tomorrow and we’re pumped. Keep an eye out for the full patch notes to hear about the rest of the changes that are coming! Naturally we’ll have more exciting Armello / LoG news shortly.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: v1.8 Shattered Kingdom Feature Reveal - New Cards
notes.content:
[i]This is a feature reveal for the upcoming Armello update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. You can find the update hub [url=armello.com/updates]here[/url].[/i]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/xuJJqs0.gif[/img]
 
[h1]Greetings Armellians![/h1]
 
Welcome to the second feature reveal for Armello’s grand new update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom. Two new cards are coming in this update, and their presence will be undeniably noticed.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i2T9irp.gif[/img]


[b]King’s Guard Armour[/b] favours characters with larger dice stacks and assists heroes in taking control of their fate, allowing a more reliable spread of useful rolls.

If you’re wondering, yes, like the Hare's Halberd all King’s Guards have this item equipped, and it will exist in the deck. This is an overall buff for King’s Guards, improving their defenses and further fortifying their role as blockers on the map.

Outlaws and the wanted beware, King’s Guards are no joke on the battlefield.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/p0HlRpi.gif[/img]

[b]Reaper’s Trident[/b] is a powerful Treasure that leverages Poison Dice in a big way. Pair this with other items that lock in Swords to cause the Poison Dice to resolve later, hopefully bypassing your opponent's shields.
 
You can also take advantage of the Rot gain to give you a leg up in your pursuit for Corruption, if you dare.


Let us know what you think of these shiny new cards and you’ll hear from us very soon, I’m sure.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Usurpers Hero Skins and Permanent Hero Skin Price Drop!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings all![/h1]

To coincide with the powerful new content update, v1.8 Shattered Kingdom, the fabled Usurpers Hero Skins will be landing in the Steam store and that means Skeeve’s Shop too. To clarify, this is not a feature announcement for v1.8, this is just relevant news!

We’re also very excited to announce that [b]all[/b] skin prices will be dropping to [b]$3.99[/b] on the same date, Usurpers Hero Skins included. We’ve got a brief FAQ down below regarding this price drop, check it out!

As always, please don’t hesitate to hit us up if you have any further questions.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/a4ea01de7672534d2042987123d7742f5e738ffe.png[/img]

[h1]Why are you dropping the price?[/h1]
With the third set of Hero Skins about to be released and the others out in the wild for some time now, our goal with this price adjustment is to nudge the Hero Skins a little closer to that fine line between special and accessible.

[h1]I purchased the Hero Skins at the previous, higher price! What gives?![/h1]
Thank you for your support, we really appreciate it. Price shifts are always going to be awkward, but they are inevitable. We trust that you’ll only make worthy and valuable purchases and your Hero Skins remain as such.

[h1]Why now?![/h1]
The Skin prices are dropping now as we are preparing to launch these Hero Skins on console, and want the prices to be the same across all platforms.

tags.balance_change: all skin prices will be dropping to [b]$3.99[/b] on the same date, Usurpers Hero Skins included.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.7.1 (patch 3)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AnHOOTu.gif[/img]

Hey community!

Here's the third hotfix for v1.7.1 with a couple of important fixes. Eternal thanks to those who submit bug reports, you are a cool breeze on a hot summer's day.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Arson can no longer be played to a tile that contains the turn taker.
[*]Buying bundles of items from the Steam store will now correctly display the count in-game.
[*]Fixed a rare NMA that could occur during quest selection.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Barnaby's AI may break in Multiplayer games, causing an NMA.[/list]


That'll be all for now folks! You'll be hearing from us very soon I'm sure.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad[/h1]

notes.title: Introducing Hero Skin Fragments
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7bul1E4CUtQsoMes/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings all,[/h1]

As you may know, Armello's new collection, Druid's Bequest, will be unearthed on the 24th of May. We're pretty excited, because this new collection holds something a little special!

Within Druid Chests, you will not only find a beautiful new array of dice, but you will also find [b]Hero Skin Fragments[/b].

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7bufj1U1UuuTWYYE/giphy.gif[/img]

There are [b]four[/b] different types of Hero Skin Fragments, one for each of the Great Clans of Armello. Transmogrifying [b]five[/b] fragments of the same type (i.e., five Wolf Clan Hero Skin Fragments) will forge a Hero Skin for a [b]random[/b] Hero of that clan. Naturally, the fragments and the skins they produce, like everything that comes out of chests, will be fully 'tradable' and 'marketable'.

We've provided a mini FAQ below, but let us know if you have any further questions surrounding fragments, and feel free to discuss below!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & The LoG Squad[/h1]


[h1]Are there Hero skin fragments for The Bandit Clan?[/h1]

The Bandit Clan do not have Hero Skin Fragments, but I'm sure that rag-tag crew will make do with their current threads.

[h1]Will the drop rates of Dice be affected?[/h1]

Obviously, with the addition of new items, the rate at which particular items drop from chests has to shift. As you know, we never share exact drop rates, but the TL;DR is that you'll simply see fewer Common and Uncommon dice, to make room for the four different Hero Skin Fragments.

You'll be happy to hear the drop rates for the rarest dice will remain largely untouched.

[h1]What are my chances of getting a Hero Skin Frament from a Chest?[/h1]

We don't discuss the specifics of drop rates, buuuuut Hero Skins were designed to be ultra rare, so you can assume the rates for the Hero Skin Fragments will be set up to support that.

Aka; They won't come quickly.

[h1]But I just bought a Hero Skin![/h1]

Thank you! Purchasing Hero Skins are still the primary method to obtain what you want, when you want. This fragment system is intended to reward dedicated players with a diverse and valuable range of items. Remember, there is no guarantee you'll Transmogrify the particular skin you're hunting for.
