notes.title: The Bandit Clan DLC Now Available & v1.7 Wyld's Ward is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AnHOOTu.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings Armellians,[/h1]

We're proud to announce that v1.7 is live right now, and with it comes glorious new features. If you're the type of person that likes to dig through patch notes, you can find them [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3116.0]here[/url].

First thing's first, the Bandit Clan have arrived.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3j8O9vr.jpg[/img]

If you haven't seen [url=https://youtu.be/Th6FhWQy0ac]The Bandit Clan launch trailer[/url] yet, it's a compulsory watch for all Armello fans.

The Bandit Clan DLC is available right now. Let it be known, the Bandit Clan is not just a hero pack. This DLC comes with a bunch of rad content, including over 50 new quests unique to Bandit Heroes - Armello's biggest lore drop to date. Find out all of the juicy details [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/398916/]here[/url].

Now, let's get to the core features found within v1.7 Wyld's Ward.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EL1Q20m.gif[/img]

Heroes that are brave enough to wield four Spirit Stones tap into enormous power. Those that hold enough to banish creatures of Black Heart are now referred to as Spirit Walkers. With this title comes grand new features.

Read all about the Wyld and Rot updates [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3105.0]here[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/P9HBvwE.gif[/img]

Armello's land bends under the will of daring adventurers. These new cards have lasting or permanent effects on the map and open the door to new strategies.

Check out the new cards [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3109.0]here[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1kZAxBE.gif[/img]

Two large new House Rules have arrived that dramatically change the dynamics of Armello's gameplay. Take control of The King's perils or be brave and play a game with Dead Player's Paw.

Check out the full details [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3114.0]here[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PET2hxM.gif[/img]

The King plunges further into insanity as a new tier of King's Declarations are added to the array. The Prestige Leader will always be kept guessing with these threatening and powerful effects.

Check out all of their juicy details [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=3115.0]here[/url].


That's a wrap! Please share the hype with all that will listen and please let us know what you think of the update.

We'll see you in Armello.


[h1]<3 Trent and LoG[/h1]

[*]Fix for applying master texture limit for different graphics options.[/list]

Happy gaming,

<3

Lisy

notes.title: v1.6 Journey's Dawn is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3q2KMIupCFD0YL3a/source.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings Armellians![/h1]

The day has finally come, v1.6 Journey's Dawn is available and live right now! Ensure your Steam client updates Armello to jump in and check out all of the new goodies. If you're the type of person that would like to jump into the patch notes, they can be found [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2981.0;topicseen]here![/url]

Along with a bunch of smaller updates and fixes, v1.6 features five the five following major features.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MwROmIx.png[/img]
[url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2962.0]Hero Skins[/url] have been implemented into Armello, along with the first wave of four skins, relevant to Amber, Mercurio, Thane and Sana. Each skin has been lovingly crafted in secret for months, with upgraded 3D models, new weapons, and all new textures, as well as brand new Hero Portraits, Chat Icons, 2D combat animations, annnnnnd a lil' dash of lore for good measure.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Qrhzw8n.png[/img]
We've been hard at work since launch, iterating and improving on our [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2963.0]multiplayer stability[/url], and we've hit a milestone that is worth celebrating. We've made leaps with the general stability of our Multiplayer systems, specifically when it comes to AI takeovers and untimely player disconnections.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PeMkCZW.png[/img]
[i]"‘Cat Burglar’ also gets a huge power boon with ‘Hero’ added to its target set, this is a huge change and we do expect the feel of Armello’s meta to change – As a history lesson, in the early prototype days of Armello, ‘Cat Burglar’ was one of the most powerful cards in the game and a real power shifter, the recent target change actually brings ‘Cat Burglar’ back to where it started and where we feel it should be."[/i]
Check the full list of changes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2982.0]here[/url].
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HVeOedi.png[/img]
[b]Discipline[/b]: Doubles the Clan Affinity Dice bonus
[b]Resist[/b]: Gain +1 Shield in Battles and Perils
Read all about these shiny little trinkets [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2991.0]here[/url].
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LwOCSiZ.png[/img]
Previously, if you wanted to make any Armello related purchase, you would have to navigate away from the Armello client and go through Steam. Luckily for us, [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2992.0]Skeeve[/url] has set up his store in an excellent location, just on the Main Menu!


That's a wrap! We hope you like it as much as we do. As always, more news of what we're up to is never too far away. Please hit us up on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url], [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitch.tv/leagueofgeeks]Twitch[/url] and tell us what you think!


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Team[/h1]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.5.1 (Patch 1)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/01071aebe20643ddd2ebab4dbda875f0dabe55fe.png[/img]

Greetings folks!

We've been busy exterminating and we've managed to destroy a few pesky bugs. This'll actually be the last update to Armello for the year. We hope you all have a great time over the holiday season! Hope you all stay safe, happy and eat a bunch of good food.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where if you needed only one star to rank up, and you earned that star in a game you didnt win (contender star, lone wolf, commendation) you would not rank up.
[*]Smoke dice should now correctly appear in the hero select screen's dice selector
[*]Uncommon/Common dice from the Traitor's Gift collection will now show the correct collection tooltip.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]When two human players Disconnect in quick succession it will cause the game to NMA. This requires a huge change that we’re currently working on. 
[*]Multiplayer player lobby may display the 'Waiting for players to be ready..." message at incorrect times. 
[*]Prologue video, Heroes and Horrors has no audio.[/list]


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG team[/h1]

notes.title: Traitor's Gift - Armello's new Dice Collection is live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Release v1.5.1!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/01071aebe20643ddd2ebab4dbda875f0dabe55fe.png[/img]

Greetings, Armellians!

Due to unforeseen difficulties with new Steam Inventory infrastructure, Armello's third Dice Collection, Traitor's Gift has been delayed. We're working as hard as we can to resolve this and get the new Collection out to you as a priority. Stay tuned for more info on that front.

The good news, however, is that we're getting a rad little update into your hands without the collection. This update brings a bunch of great stuff that we're sure you'll like.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ghor Hero Power change:  In Forests, Spells cost 1 Magic less for each [b]adjacent[/b] Forest and Ghor can cast to any Forest. Ghor does not gain Stealth in Forests at Night. 
[*]Ghor Hero Power visualisation change: Only the Ghor player sees the Forest glowing particles. 
[*]River Hero Power change:  It’s been a long time coming to bring River’s Hero Power in line with how it’s managed. River’s hero power is now correctly treated like an attack in all cases.
- Now triggers Prestige loss vs. King.
- Now triggers a Traitor level Bounty vs. King.
- Now triggers a Wanted level Bounty vs. King's Guard.
- Now removes 3 Prestige during Peace Treaty vs. Hero.
- Now breaks Armistice Pact and become Wanted vs. Pact Hero.
[*]The King’s Voice Over (VO) has received some mastering and polishing.
[*]Due to popular demand, the King now roars again..
[*]Bounty communications now have unique audio SFX. 
[*]Commendation screen now has unique audio SFX.
[*]On completing a public multiplayer game, all human players will receive a Contender Star.
[*]When using a controller, dice are now thrown in the correct direction.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a rare NMA cause by dying on your turn with an active Pact. 
[*]Lone Wolf has been removed from Private games.
[*]Fixed a bug where Tool Tips for Dice show a string. If you see this again, please let us know!
[*]Controllers will now be able to interact with Steam Profiles on the Commendation page. 
[*]Fixed Cards animation in inventories/hands/card gallery. 
[*]Fixed King's Declaration layering over the player's hero shelf. 
[*]Fixed Missing particle on Signet/Ring unlock progression. 
[*]Fixed a visual bug where a player who has left a game via the 'game ready' pop up may have their name appear in the lobby for the next game.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where the trailers in the prologue menu may copy one another, and play the same trailer regardless of which one is clicked. 
[*]Fixed a bug where the in-game pause menu may become unresponsive when attempting to quit a Prologue or Multiplayer game.[/list]

Many of these changes have been implemented due to public request, so thank you to all those who went out of their way to provide constructive feedback.


Cheers,

[h1]<3 Darcy & the LoG Team[/h1]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.5 (Patch 4)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/01071aebe20643ddd2ebab4dbda875f0dabe55fe.png[/img]

Hi all,

Another Hotfix has been cooked up for all you fine Armellians!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an NMA that can occurs when a Player selects their Ring or Amulet at the last few seconds of the Hero select screen. This would cause mismatches in Players stats across clients and subsequently usually result in combat getting stuck.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would stall on the loading screen that could occur when accepting a Multiplayer invite for either Public or Private while being in a singplayer game.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some cards are not animating when in inventories/hands/card gallery. 
[*]King's Declaration layering over the player's hero shelf. 
[*]Missing particle on Signet/Ring unlock progression. 
[*]Multiplayer player lobby may display the 'Waiting for players to be ready..." message at incorrect times. 
[*]A player who has left a game via the 'game ready' pop up may have their name appear in the lobby for the next game, this however will not impact the game or lobby. (This is a visual bug only). 
[*]Rare issue where the trailers in the prologue menu may copy one another, and play the same trailer regardless of which one is clicked. 
[*]In-game pause menu may become unresponsive when attempting to quit a Prologue or Multiplayer game (unpausing and repausing can fix this issue). This only occurs during the introduction to Thane's Prologue.
[/list]

<3 

Lisy & the LoG crew!

notes.title: v1.5 Art of Treason, now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/01071aebe20643ddd2ebab4dbda875f0dabe55fe.png[/img]

Today is the big day!

v1.5 Art of Treason is out, live and playable right now and we’re excited. This is also the big day that the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/398915]Seasons Board Skins Pack[/url] becomes available for purchase, so please check that out. If that wasn't enough, Armello is on sale starting right now at [b]30% off[/b] which is the deepest discount we've ever done. It's the perfect time to spread the good word and get your pals on board.

Seriously, this is an enormous update. I’m going to lay out some of the features for you in case you missed our rolling feature reveals throughout the week. This update has a huuuuge list of rad additions so you can check out the patch notes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2817.0]here[/url], if that’s your thing. SO let’s get started!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/bb203f3a471af2bd78573a9823f51e465d398149.png[/img]
Check the full New Cards feature announcement [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2790.0]here[/url].

Five new cards have landed in the world of Armello. This set of cards will feature one new Follower and four new Trickery cards. Muster all of your cunning, venture forth and master these cards.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3vRcE4o6JxvQZ0w8/source.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/aa9f6f03a07681cd00ae64d995341eabe7462467.png[/img]
Check the full UX Improvements feature announcement [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2805.0]here[/url].

Between the dawn summary panel, upgraded pact communications, updated end-game screen, a new multiplayer lobby, inventory updates and more - there are a HUGE amount of tweaks that landed in v1.5.

Get in there and experience the glory!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3vQXtJTCqxWvg6yY/source.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/320eb7d67d5795dcfdd3410e5ca8c4510c3af42d.png[/img]
Check the full Scaling Bounty feature announcement [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2812.0]here[/url].

Each dawn while a Hero has a Bounty on their head their Level of Bounty will increase. This represents the that the target of interest is still at large and the King’s patience is wearing thin, additionally we’ve changed the way the rewards are issued with each Bounty level and they multiply with each increase in level like this;

[i]Level 1 – ‘Wanted’ reward is 1 Prestige and 2 Gold
Level 2 – ‘Fugitive’ reward is 2 Prestige and 4 Gold
Level 3 – ‘Traitor’ reward is 3 Prestige and 6 Gold[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2Pehk5X.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/f9cdf3c8be46a2739e6acfe8b7568139cd0fd7e2.png[/img]
Check the full Multiplayer Progression feature announcement [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2818.0;topicseen]here[/url].

This is a big one. Whether joining the public queue or playing private games with your pals, there's something here for you. After participating in online multiplayer games (whether public or private), players can ascend in level, unlocking new portraits, frames, and increasing the skill level of players you're matched with online.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oz8xr36XHIiZcBtp6/source.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/bdcae72152ecfd94aef5b3d06dd4969450949e24.png[/img]

Last but not least, the King has found his voice. Throughout the game, the King will now audibly banter with and taunt heroes. He may or may not laugh at you if you fail his perils.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/acdc1f1656d785a891ef7be0fe7b93245bd2349b.png[/img]

And there we have it! Please let us know what you think over on [url=twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url]. Thanks for being such a rad community. See you in the Multiplayer queue!


[h1]<3 Darcy and the LoG Team[/h1]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/1abff193bd6d7fc041982a51ca6f1a45aee01591.png[/img]

[i]There’s a chill in the air, a kind of eeriness that’s not been felt in awhile.[/i]

[list]

<3

Lisy & the LoG crew.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.2 (Patch 5)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/1abff193bd6d7fc041982a51ca6f1a45aee01591.png[/img]

Hey Armellians!

I'm back from TwitchCon which was a rad little experience, getting to meet Armellians and content creators alike!

No rest, we've got another hot fix fresh out of the oven for you all.

Thank you so much to those who've sent through bug reports to help us hunt them and slay. But, without further ado:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where if a player disconnecting during Combat as the authority player, in their next multiplayer game they would NMA on their first combat.
[*]Fixed an issue where a player disconnecting during the King playing Perils at night would cause the game to NMA on the King.
[*]Fixed an issue where a player disconnecting at the same time of their turn ending as an AI is starting their turn would cause the game to NMA.
[*]Fixed an issue for low end machines (machines around our minimum specs) that if Sargon retreated after being the attacker in a combat, it could cause performance issues.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]An issue remains where Scout can be permanently granted to a Palace tile. 
[*]The 'Machiavellian' achievement is currently not functioning.[/list]

<3

Lisy & the LoG crew.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.2 (Patch 4)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/1abff193bd6d7fc041982a51ca6f1a45aee01591.png[/img]

Heyo Armellians!

Lisy and Darcy are away at Twitchcon so I've got the reigns at the moment! ahahahaha! Just like old times, eh?! Feels gooood, man. 

But yeah, apart from the partying and brazenberry ale fuelled nights, we have actually been working away on a bunch of issues, so here's a hotfix for y'all!

As usual, if you've been submitting bugs you have our eternal gratitude. You also now have the added pleasure of seeing some of those bugs' heads on a pike here in this announcement. So without further ado...  

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where disconnecting during combat could cause the A.I. to not continue its next turn.
    [*]Fixed a rare issue where a player would disconnect immediately after ending their turn, causing an NMA.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]A player disconnecting whilst the King is playing perils at night can cause an NMA.
    [*]An issue remains where Scout can be permanently granted to a Palace tile.
    [*]A rare issue where Ghor can stay in Wyldkin form after death. This will reset when you go into/out of a forest. Poor Ghor.
    [*]The 'Machiavellian' achievement is currently not functioning. 
[/list]

[i]Note: 'NMA' is our acronym for No More Actions and describes bugs where the player/s are unable to progress the game[/i]. 

That's about it, folks! Keep those bug reports coming in. If you encounter any of the known issues, please send in bug reports. Also, we're currently focusing on network and multiplayer stability so if you're having issues with that specifically, we want to see your logs! 


[b]<3 Trent & the LoG crew![/b]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/1abff193bd6d7fc041982a51ca6f1a45aee01591.png[/img]

Hello Armellians, 

Thanks to everyone who's been submitting any bugs they've seen in the land of Armello. We present to you some of those bugs; now squished.. 

[i]NMA is our acronym for No More Action. [/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented a fix for the ordering of Combat, the Attacker always goes first now. This will fix a wide assortment of client mismatch issues.
[*]Fixed a card draw bug where cards would not longer be able to be selected during the draw phase. 
[*]Fixed multiple End Turn bugs.[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]

[list]
[*]There is a rare disconnect NMA still floating around when a player disconnects causing NMA. 
[*]A rare issue where Ghor can sometimesstay in tree form after death. This will resets when you go into/out of a forest. Poor Ghor.
[*]Machiavellian is currently not functioning. 
[*]A rare issue where Spy network gets stuck on Palace Tiles.[/list]

Happy gaming folks! 

<3 

Lisy & the LoG crew!

notes.title: v1.4.1 Spoils of War now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/b989073bddf907d3d1b32e4cdfffe786c8744cfa.gif[/img]

Hello Armellians!

Welcome to the new era that is [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437135631/announcements/detail/603866480482148376]Collection 2, Spoils of War[/url]. Along with this fresh new dice collection we’ve actually added two brand spanking new cards fresh out of the dev-kitchen. Now, when searching for your perfect gear, you may just stumble across an Iron Pike (Item) or a Silver Lance (Treasure).

Also, the previous update, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791437135631/announcements/detail/608366788027771976]v1.4 Battle Tides[/url], brought forth the Poison and Reflect dice modifiers, along with a few broader changes to the combat mechanics. These additions and tweaks had a significant impact on many equippable item cards. In this update, we’ve swept through and made some adjustments to ensure your favourite equippables remain fun and have a place in Armello’s ecosystem.

We really hope you dig all of these changes. Soar like eagles.

[h1]Features and Changes[/h1]

[b]Collection - Spoils of War[/b]
[list]
[*]Spoils of War chests and keys will now drop at the end of Public Multiplayer games instead of the Wyld chests and keys.
[*]These chests and keys will also be available for purchase through our Steam Item Store for US$1.49 each. You can access this via Inventory or our Steam store page. 
[*]Chests and keys will still be tradable and marketable on the Steam marketplace.
[*]You can not transmogrify across collections e.g. three Wyld dice and two Spoils of War dice. [/list]

[h1]New Cards[/h1]
[list]
[*]Silver Lance (Treasure): In Battle, +1 Sword with Pierce. On Plains, gain an additional +1 Sword with Pierce.
[*]Iron Pike (Item): In Battle, when Attacking, first rolled Sword gains Pierce; when Defending Reflect.
[/list]

[h1]Card Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Battle Axe (Item): Gold cost reduced to 1 Gold.
[*]Hand Cannons (Treasure): In Battle, first 2 burned Suns are Piercing Attacks.
[*]Long Bow (Item): In Battle, first burned Moon is a Pierce.
[*]Oak Spear (Item): In Battle, +1 Sword and when defending +1 bonus Sword.
[*]Chainmail Shirt (Item): In Battle, +1 Shield, and first Burned Shield gains Reflect.
[*]Poisoned Dagger (Item):In Battle, Burn a Rot to make all rolled Swords gain Poison.
[*]Snake Venom (Item): In Battle, until end of next turn, Burn a Rot to make all rolled Swords gain Poison.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an NMA where Bribery is used to take the Stranger while another player is Exploring.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]End Turn bug - we still have an issue with the end turn button disappearing at times, try things like opening your hero shelf/inventory when other actions that force your end turn button off screen  (such as quests, combat etc). We have additional logging to find the cause. 
[*]Rare NMA from disconnecting players in multiplayer games.[/list]

notes.title: Armello - Usurpers Hero Pack coming August 30!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/b1676ed0b9c12cd209792739e47ba3a227e44f46.png[/img]


[h1]View the Usurpers Teaser Trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Enq3fAUnps]here[/url].[/h1]

Get ready to join the fray for Armello's throne with four new playable [b]Heroes[/b] and four new [b]Rings[/b] - one for each Clan! 

[h1]New Heroes[/h1]

Elyssia, Wardress of Warrens - Rabbit Clan

Sargon, the Death Teller - Rat Clan

Magna, the Unbroken - Wolf Clan

Ghor, the Wyldkin - Bear Clan

Thanks to everyone who's been submitting any bugs they've seen in the land of Armello. We present to you some of those bugs;  now deceased. 

Without further ado here are the fixes we've implemented!

[i]NMA is our acronym for No More Action.[/i]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Support changes for the Double Dip Weekend. 
[*]Fixed a rare NMA when The Stranger transferring Heroes and a player interacting with multiple Hero shelves.
[*]Fixed a rare NMA caused by repeatedly pressing End Turn while their Hero is dying.
[*]Fixed a rare NMA caused by selecting a Quest Rumour during the King's Declaration phase.
Fixed a rare NMA caused by a player disconnecting during a combat with the Mirror Cape.
[*]Improvements to when the End Turn button is shown and hidden.
[*]Fixed an issue where quitting a game during the King's Dec phase would prevent new games from starting correctly.
[*]Fix rare issue where Palisade Walls graphic would be missing from continued games.
[*]Fixed the sound of the Special Dice to not be deafening.
[*]Fixed an issue with Special Dice sounds not being controlled by SFX Audio slider. 
[*]Fixed some of our Artists signatures on Card Art for Low Graphics settings.
[*]Fixed the “New” Ribbon on the Card Gallery not updating in one session.
[*]Fixed an issue with Inventory items not hiding properly when entering the Multiplayer Lobby.
[*]Fixed some changes to the Prologue wording around Prestige and Gold.
[*]Fixed a rare bug around Scout and Evading near palace tiles. 
[*]Fixed an issue with when dying from Overkill and having Poison Dice you would respawn Poisoned. [/list]

Happy gaming everyone!

<3

Lisy

notes.content:
Armello [official site], the virtual board game about royal politicking and cutesy, wide-eyed Disneyfied critters, got a new update this week. Battle Tides, update 1.4, brings a slew of free new features and fixes to the game.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: v1.4 Battle Tides is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/1abff193bd6d7fc041982a51ca6f1a45aee01591.png[/img]

Greetings to you, best community in the world!

The time is nigh, as v1.4 Battle Tides has just landed on Steam! This is our fourth, free, major update and it’s packed to the brim with glorious features and tweaks. I’m going to run through the major features, but you can take a look at every single nut and bolt in the patch notes, [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2507]here[/url].

Let’s launch into the features that v1.4 Battle Tides brings.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/46f76fafc586a8fcc8ea807de68578c5f09e31e0.png[/img]

Five new glorious cards will be gracing Armello. These are primarily focused on further empowering the player to make tactical decisions, whether it comes to leaving your mark in combat or protecting your settlements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/47f7a825a7c6f075b70afaafcd22e3e0c4f9e1fd.gif[/img]
[i]Art and Animation for Poison Taster by Jerome Jacinto[/i]

[list]
[*]Poison Taster (Follower): Removes Poison and gives immunity while Recruited.
[*]Poisoned Dagger (Item): In Battle, First Burned Rot Card is a Poisoned Attack.
[*]Hero’s Shield (Treasure): In Battle, +1 Reflecting Shield
[*]Snake Venom (Consumable): (Play to) Creature; In Battle, first rolled Rot counts as a Poison Attack until end of next turn.
[*]Palisade Walls (Trickery): (Play on) Settlement; Settlement is Fortified until Terrorised, or until owner changes. SFX audio to support this.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/3172680cd69ea63298d09ff666c29c98b6f96830.png[/img]

The Piercing Dice got a little lonely, but fear not! Two new “special” dice have been added to spice up Armello combat!

[b]Reflect[/b] – Blocks the incoming hit and bounces back the damage to the attacker, which may be blocked again by their own defences.
[b]Poison[/b] – If this hit isn’t blocked and thus causes a wound to the target, it will “poison” the victim.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/ac3d35cf7e5ea1ff9f97cce4115df7095bb3f4c1.gif[/img]
[i]Art and Animation for Poisoned Dagger by Simon Boxer[/i]

With the addition of these awesome new combat features, we’ve modified a few things to clean up combat and future-proof the system for bigger and better things! Special dice like Poison and Pierce now resolve in the order that they were created, simple as that!

Also If two special dice collide they will cancel each other out and behave as their base dice type. Thus a ‘pierce’ dice meeting a ‘reflect’ dice won’t pierce the ‘reflect’ and the ‘reflect’ won’t bounce back a ‘piercing’ dice."

If you’re the type of person that craves details, check out this detailed blog post by League of Geeks co-founder and director, Blake Mizzi, [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2496.msg18042#msg18042]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/7b03fd70acc7160d02e82a76d521eb983b4a66e6.png[/img]

A cool thing about card and board games is that when you tweak a few values on cards, the result can be a completely fresh gameplay experience. This time, we’ve got a big old list of tweaks and adjustments, a bunch that are based on community feedback!

Here are three specific highlights of the changes that landed in v1.4 Battle Tides!


[i][b]Hot Rot Wine (Item):[/b] Now costs 1 Rot instead of 1 Gold to play.[/i]
It’s cool that players use Hot Rot Wine to score last turn victories. In fact, it’s really important that every player feels like they can win, even up to their last turn. We don’t necessarily want Hot Rot Wine to be the “best” way to get a combat victory in every scenario, so now by inflicting a Rot, all non-rotty players will suffer a further disadvantage when fighting the King, whereas the heavily Corrupted get a much needed boon.

[i][b]Blacksmith (Follower)[/b]: New effect; in Battle, +1 Sword/Shield for first Sword and Shield symbol Equipped.[/i]
Heroes with the Blacksmith by their side felt a little too invincible for our liking. Now, with the correct gear equipped he provides a maximum of 2 pre-locked symbols in combat. Powerful but fair.

[i][b]Welcoming Party (Trickery)[/b]: New effect: Target is exiled to nearest unoccupied Mountain and ends Targets Turn.[/i]
We really like versatile cards but we feel that most experienced Players were using Welcoming Party strictly as a mode of transportation rather than a peril. Now, it’s a threatening Peril AND it can absolutely still be used for movement. You may just need to be a little more crafty.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/d14c3a371ac62cfaa81391e9176638d72725b7f5.png[/img]

We've been keeping an eye on how you, our beautiful players interact with each other and we've made a few changes! LoG co-founder, Trent "good hair" Kusters bares all the juicy details [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2496.msg18042#msg18042]here[/url]. We've replaced a few lesser used chat options with some rad additions.

Once again, I’ve chosen three to show off but there are a heap!

[b]"Exclaim" > "Curse"[/b] for when the Wyld fails to shine upon you.
[b]"Truce" > "Hero"[/b] to suggest an allegiance in a pinch.
[b]"Farewell"[/b] is the perfect way to end a match, or an opponent.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l46CChknVNKJeduE0/giphy.gif[/img]

Alright folks, that’s the scenic tour of v1.4 Battle Tides but I’m excited to see you jump in and discover all of the juicy details that weren’t even mentioned!

Definitely follow us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/leagueofgeeks]Twitch[/url] and tune in at [b]7:30pm on the 6th July PDT[/b] as we’ll be streaming some v1.4 Battle Tides and giving away some goodies to our viewers!

Remember to holla at us with your feedback on [url=http://twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url], [url=http://facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and the forums ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/]Steam[/url] & [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/]LoG[/url])!


May the Wyld guide your path.

<3 Lisy & the LoG Crew

notes.title: Hotfix v1.3 [Steam PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 1)
notes.content:
HEY ARMELLO FAMILY!

An extra hot, hotfix is here, straight out of the codery oven. Thanks to everyone for submitting their detailed logs and emails, you’re all beautiful butterflies. Here’s the latest fixes that have made it into Armello! 

If you’re an individual that is experiencing any Disconnects in multiplayer games we’d like you (the person who disconnected) to submit your logs (even if you don’t think you’ve experienced a bug), as we are investigating some bugs that we are unable to reproduce in the studio. 

Also thanks to Steam user: Anko we’ve been notified that anti-virus programs including and similar to AVG are causing conflicts with Armello. If you are experiencing any crashes or performance issues, we recommend checking that your Anti-Virus programs have Armello as an exception OR try disabling them all together for the interim. 

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]We’ve expanded the Regions in which a game will search for on our Steam multiplayer platform.[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Continuing Singleplayer saved games should now work as intended. 
[*]Fixed issues where certain buttons weren’t displaying when using Family Share.
[*]Fixed a rare NMA caused when a player steals another player's Card. 
[*]Fixed a rare NMA caused by a player opening their Rumour Panel while the King is playing Perils during the night phase.

notes.title: Release v1.2.1
notes.content:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/248/51ace5a55c661fbd1c406bda23149b16_original.png?v=1455751446&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9bad85209a170e2362c89af91a5562a7[/img]

Hey Armello Fam!

Here's a brand new release to add even more juiciness to the v1.2 The Stranger release, enjoy!

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]A range of new visualisations have been implemented to support The Stranger's peculiar behaviour including:
[list]
[*]New particles to indicate when the Stranger swaps and when the Stranger moves a Hero.
[*]The overhead icon now appears when a Hero is moved from the Stranger.
[*]New text and communication from the Stranger to add flavour.[/list]
[*]The Stranger's combat transfer mechanic has been replaced with a non-combat transfer system. Now, any hero that ends their turn with [i]or[/i] adjacent to The Stranger, will trigger a potential host swap.
[*]You can now choose to dismiss the Stranger in House Rules.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]The Stranger now force equips when stolen with Bribery.
[*]Fixed a card layering issue that could occur on the decks during the draw phase.
[*]The Stranger will now correctly appear in the Card Gallery when it is equipped!
[/list]

[u][b]Need More Info:[/b][/u]
We have improved the logging surrounding these particularly rare occurrences. Please let us know if you encounter any of the following issues.
[list]
[*]On rare occasions, card draw fails and breaks the flow of gameplay, resulting in an NMA (No More Action state).
[*]On launch, the player may be confronted with a white screen, blocking progress into the game and causing an NMA.
[*]Multiplayer combat NMA. If encountered, it's important that we receive logs from all players in that game.
[*]A tile may appear blocked, restricting movement for seemingly no reason.[/list]


As always, if you see something, say something. If you encounter any buggy weirdness, please let us know over [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/]here[/url] OR submit an in-game Bug report.


THANKS ALL!

<3 Darcy

notes.title: Hotfix v1.2 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 3)
notes.content:
[img=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/248/51ace5a55c661fbd1c406bda23149b16_original.png?v=1455751446&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9bad85209a170e2362c89af91a5562a7]

Hey Armellians,

Another update from LoG HQ, we’ve fixed some minor bugs as well as a few NMA’s (No More Action’s), here are the full details:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]A fix for Spanish language users to stop a rare case of the game going into NMA when The Stranger was acquired. 
[*]Bane's will now correctly explode/die when pushed or spawned into Stone Circles.
[*]The Trickery Discount will now correctly be applied in a continued game.
[*]A rare bug where The Stranger would get stuck on screen if the player had their inventory open has been fixed.
[*]A rare bug where a player would encounter a Palace Peril multiple times if they had nowhere to retreat to has been fixed.
[*]A speculative fix has been applied to stop players going into NMA states upon card draw.
[*]Multiple and various typo/localisation fixes for English, Portuguese Brazilian and Spanish. 
[*]Fixed a rare case where a player completing their quest on a Dungeon, and getting The Stranger from the same Dungeon, on the same turn would cause an NMA.[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]When a player is disconnected or leaves a Public Multiplayer game the incorrect icon may appear.
[*]A rare combat NMA where dice becomes unresolved, we've been unable to reproduce this in the studio and have not yet received full Logs for this. If you get an online NMA, it's important for ALL players to submit logs. [/list]

If you encounter any more bugs be sure to let us know over [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/]here[/url] OR submit an in-game Bug report.

Cheers guys!

<3

notes.title: Hotfix v1.2 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 2)
notes.content:
[img=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/248/51ace5a55c661fbd1c406bda23149b16_original.png?v=1455751446&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9bad85209a170e2362c89af91a5562a7]

Hey Armellians,

The hottest of fixes is fresh from the oven ready for you to jump on in. We’ve fixed some minor bugs as well as a few NMA’s (No More Action’s), here are the full details:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an NMA caused by the Bane Blade card effect.
[*]Fixed an NMA if you play two cards on a human player Hero in quick succession the target no longer NMA.
[*]The Stranger will no longer move you before your Card Draw which fixes a myriad of issues.
[*]Fixed an NMA where a player with The Stranger equipped would enter the Palace AND there was at least one player using non-English text.
[*]Saved Games across updates will now correctly be deleted resulting in Singleplayer games working as intended.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you start your turn on a Quest The Stranger will move you but you will still encounter the Quest. [/list]

These NMA’s would also have given the player the impression that Turn Timers and the AFK feature was not functioning. 

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]There are still edge case NMA’s where The Stranger attempts to swap from Combat, we haven’t been able to reproduce in the studio so please keep sending through your logs for these.
[*]There is an “infinite” card draw bug that may have been fixed and we have not been reproduce this in the studio so please keep sending through the logs. 
[*]If a player goes onto a Dungeon and gets The Stranger and then at the same time encounters any Quest, then Peril scouting will be broken for that player for the rest of the game.[/list]

If you encounter any more bugs be sure to let us know over [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/1/]here[/url] OR submit an in-game Bug report.

Cheers guys!

<3

Lisy aka yosafbridge

So it turns out that The Stranger brought along some unexpected bugs that we have tracked down and hopefully obliterated. Thanks to all who reached out with detailed descriptions and logs. If you encounter further issues, please be sure to let us know.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Transferring The Stranger after a combat death now function correctly.
[*]The Stranger will now correctly flee when it's hero lands on a Palace tile.
[*]Perils that have been peeked at are now always correctly dismissible. 
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]If you start your turn on a Quest The Stranger will move you but you will still encounter the Quest. 
[*]There are some NMA's being caused from the Stranger moving you into certain states before Card Draw.
[*]If you play two cards on a human player Hero in quick succession the target may NMA.[/list]

We appreciate your patience!

<3 Darcy aka WordSlice

notes.title: v1.2 The Stranger has Arrived
notes.content:
[img=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/248/51ace5a55c661fbd1c406bda23149b16_original.png?v=1455751446&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9bad85209a170e2362c89af91a5562a7]

Heyo Armellians!

The Stranger, v1.2 has arrived on Steam in all it’s glory! This is our second, free, major update since launch, jam-packed with fun stuff that we’re excited to tell you all about it. If you’re the type of person that prefers patch notes rather than my charming summary, first of all, ouch. Second of all, [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2235.0]here you go[/url]!

As always, for the purpose of ensuring this update is stable experience for PS4 and DRM Free, this update will land on these platforms a few weeks down the track,  


First of all, a gross new Dice Skin event is live [b]right now[/b], so play Public Multiplayer games to unlock the limited and exclusive Stranger Dice. This event will end [b]Wednesday 24th PST[/b].

[img=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/568/06a527da93ba954ecfaabf74fbf30751_original.gif?v=1455755435&w=639&fit=max&q=92&s=d2d6cc13790761629c7abd4be79ae03f]

This time, you'll get one set within the first 1 - 2 Public Multiplayer games you play, and then another set every 3 - 6 other Public Multiplayer games you play. This will ensure you get your set quickly but will allow for hoarding, gifting and trading through Steam's Inventory system.

[h1]The Stranger[/h1]

The Stranger is a mysterious and powerful Follower card that does not abide by the standard deck rules. When a Hero stumbles across it in a Dungeon, it insists on joining their adventure and nothing will stop it from doing so. Not even other Followers. If The Stranger’s Hero dies in combat, it will manipulate its way into the party of the victor and continue with its torment.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/XZsIVtS.gif]

If The Stranger is in your party, at the start of your turn, it will lead you to a random adjacent tile at no AP cost. This effect can be a nuisance but if harnessed correctly, can be incredibly powerful.

And a few words of wisdom, The Stranger absolutely cannot stand the Palace.

[h1]New House Rules[/h1]

Here we have a few options for you to play with that completely shift the dynamic of the game. We like to keep the experience of smashing your friends fresh, so please enjoy these new game changing rules.

[list]
[*]King Dawn Damage: By turning The King’s standard dawn damage off, [*]The King will continue to rule Armello until the heroes intervene.
[*]The Mad King: Each night, The King ensures there are at least 4 perils on the board.
[*]Starting Hand Type: There are three options here, Default; an even distribution of Item, Spell and Trickery cards, Random; start with completely random cards and Draw; Choose which decks to draw your starting hand from on your first turn.
[*]Hero Wits: Heroes gain a passive bonus to Wits.
[*]Hero Starting Equipment: Each hero starts with either a random Treasure or a random Follower.[/list]

[h1]New Cards[/h1]

With this shiny new batch of interesting cards, we are really focusing on forethought and strategy. Block an opponent's path by casting a Rotten Fog or stop them by force by standing in their way, armed with a Tower Shield. Avoid confrontation by forcing an opponent into an Armistice and steal the King's ear by hosting a most splendid Bubble Tea party.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/wDkQ6cC.gif]

[list]
[*]Tower Shield (Item): In Battle, +1 Shield, and when Defending gain another +1 Shield.
[*]Bubble Tea (Item): (Play on) Hero, +1 Prestige until the end of target's next Turn.
[*]Rotten Fog (Spell): (Play on Empty Tile) Plains, Forest, Dungeon; Creates a toxic -1 Health Fog on the Tile until next Dawn
[*]Armistice (Trickery): (Play on) Hero (Not Self); If either Hero attacks the other, they'll be given a Bounty[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]

All Heroes have had their Body Stat increased by one. Here’s a snippet of insight regarding this decision from LoG Design Guru and Co-Founder, Blake.

[i]“One (1) Body is usually all there is between death and hanging on by your last thread. And being close to death feels better than being dead. Now, with the Body increase, if you hit a nasty Peril or fail your first battle there’s a good chance that instead of death, you’ll escape, broken, bleeding but alive. You can then heal, flee, strike back, but most importantly it gives you that choice. Basically, giving all Heroes +1 Body, gives players room to make “some” mistakes and lessens the impact of random and opportunistic occurrences.”[/i]

Read Blake’s full dissection [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2240.0]here[/url].

In addition to this, significant tweaks have been made to Card costs, primarily in the Trickery Deck to further promote interesting choices in card play. Oh, and let’s not forget Stealth. We have made stealth even more sneaky by hiding certain actions from the status feed and removing a few other unavoidable “tells”.

[h1]Muiltiplayer Improvements[/h1]

We learnt a lot from the Winter Dice event. Lesson one was that people love their frosty dice. Lesson two was that all sorts of characters come out of the woodwork, including AFKers and hackers. At the end of the day, we want people to enjoy playing Armello in it’s purest form and will always fight to preserve that. As such, we have added AFK timers and improved Steam VAC (anti-hack protection).

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]

Have you ever taken a step before remembering that you were Poisoned a minute ago? Well this should happen less, now that the Poisoned effect is now very obvious. You’ll find that a few other cards have fancy new visualisations too.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/hAK2NLn.gif]

The most obvious improvement that we’ve made in terms of visuals is increasing text size in most areas once again. This makes Armello more accessible overall and more effectively accommodates players who like to sit further from the screen, say, in a lounge room setting.

Also! A Deck shuffle graphic has been implemented which notifies all players when a Deck has been depleted and is in the process of being replenished. This further fortifies the board-game-y-ness of Armello and assists high level players in tracking essential cards.

[h1]That's a Wrap[/h1]

The crew here at LoG are in a really good rhythm at the moment, so future updates and even unannounced super top secret DLC are well underway. We have so much more exciting content to share with you but for the time being we hope you have a ball with v1.2. Remember to let us know what you think on [url=http://twitter.com/armellogame]Twitter[/url], [url=http://facebook.com/armellogame]Facebook[/url] and the forums ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/290340/discussions/]Steam[/url] & [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php]LoG[/url])!

If you like Armello and you want, positive reviews on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/290340/]Steam[/url] go a really long way in making us feel warm and fuzzy, along with increasing our overall visibility.

Thank you all for your support!

<3 Darcy and the LoG Crew

notes.title: v1.1.1 Armellians' (even louder) Roar & Holiday Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/049/560/95080b94084c29e8ab3ad6d9b517e38b_original.png?v=1449634593&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4bf7c1447c09c64a40dc0ed934192800[/img]

Greetings friends!

Firstly, we want to wish you all a very happy holidays! We hope you all kick back and relax, play games and eat a whole bunch of food.

We're excited and a lil festive right now because a cool little update just went live on Steam! This has a few awesome presents and introduces some new background infrastructure, opening doors for sweet, sweet future content.

You may notice a few tweaks such as the News Feed on the main menu, which will keep you up to date with all things Armello!

The full patch notes can be found [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2062]here[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/044/410/20f8e5c302615a5145f29de39525343e_original.png?v=1449553393&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=238c2293658a4c1163ea94cc9541ba70[/img]

WARNING: These glorious Dice are absurdly frosty. When rolled, the outcome can be conservatively described as an ice explosion.

Seriously though, whether you're overcoming chilly perils or cutting down enemies with a frigid blade, these are sure to bring on Winter's bite.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/054/319/808432f52011a5c0f4036a74b0f61cdf_original.png?v=1449710042&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=830488ae344b7e1e79503969accce259[/img]

These dice are awarded by playing [b]public multiplayer games on Steam between the 21st and the 31st of December (PST)[/b]. Be sure to jump on and play during this period for your chance to score a set! 

Considering these are a Steam Inventory drop, these dice will also be available for trading between players and on the Steam Marketplace, so an alternative is to find a worthy traveler willing to trade a set.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/044/412/74777006922cd997c0f559ecaeb4e04b_original.png?v=1449553450&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5b030f1ecfa2ecc98b2483552954fc6d[/img]

We have been working super hard and it's about time we rest our weary feet for a little bit. As such, over the holiday period we'll of course be around if anything catches on fire and we'll do our best to stay active online, but you can expect to hear less from us through all channels until the second week of January. We'll be chillin with our families on the golden sands of Australia's beautiful beaches.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/054/445/42bbce9ca2c9895d4e49d0fa03964706_original.png?v=1449711534&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ce0da6e6cec872d41de3f303feab7791[/img]

However, as with everything LoG, there is always a JUICY CATCH! The regular stream schedule will come be switched out for our super special holiday [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=2063.0]stream schedule[/url]!

We've got a couple of huge broadcasts scheduled, so if you're floating around during the holidays, tune in and say hi!

See you all in Armello!

[b]<3 Darcy and the LoG Crew[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 3)
notes.content:
YO!

Our third patch for v1.1 just went live! Thanks for all of your feedback and your reports, it really helps us track down and squash bugs including No-More-Actions (NMA's):

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Implemented a patch for Unity which will fix crashes experienced in Ubuntu / Nvidia. 
[*]Fixed an white screen NMA that occurred when loading into a rare case in Multiplayer House Rules initialisation. 
[*]Fixed an NMA when a player passes a Quest and receives a Spirit Stone, if they also then spawn a secret encounter the game would break. 
[*]Fixed an issue which would occur when a public queue would be dismissed by unresponsive/AFK players and the game would then have a miss-matched/incorrect public lobby.
[*]Fixed an NMA when the authority would disconnect from anywhere in-game and the player who is the next to be the authority was also the next turn taker (from the original authority player).
[*]Fixed an NMA where House Rules becomes mismatched across a multiplayer game and the game would fall out of sync. 
[*]Attempting to open/close the Hero Shelf during the King’s Declaration will no longer cause an NMA.
[*]Fixed some wildcard typo’s In the German localisation the Gypsy Caravan quest.
[*]Fixed a typo in the “Rain Dance” quest (English only).
[*]King’s Guards should no longer be spawned on the same tile if they are spawned during the same Dawn phase. For real this time. 
[*]All quests in gendered languages (such as German, French, Spanish) will now use the correct gender for all Heroes, instead of always using female.
[*]Fixed a rare occurrence of a “Warning error” appearing at the final Quest, only in non-English languages but not all (Korean and Spanish were reported).
[*]Single-player games will correctly unpause if a multiplayer queue pops and expires while in the King’s Declaration state.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list][*]If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)[/list]

May your journey for the throne be peril-free.

<3

Darcy and the LoG Team.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 2) [PC/Mac/Linux]
notes.content:
Hey y’all,

Thanks to those who have continued to submit bug reports and logs to us, you’ve really helped us get this patch together!

So here are the fixes we’ve implemented, keep in mind that NMA means No More Action:

[list]
[*]We have figured out a solution to the crashes Armellilans have been experiencing while starting a game. We’ve rolled back the version of Unity we upgraded to for v1.1 which was the primary cause for these NMA’s. 
[*]Fixed NMA caused by Spirit Stone mismatch.
[*]Fixing \ns in TUTORIAL_SPEED_UP_INPUT_INFO.[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)
[*]If you're in a private game lobby (NOT queueing for a public game) and you go play a single player game, House Rules will be reset locally (this can cause the private game to be out of sync). So don't play single player while you're waiting for a​ private​ game.
[*]Don't change House Rules while someone is in the process of joining a private lobby - either do it before you invite them or after they've joined.[/list]

Once again, thanks for all your help and let you conquer Armello!

<3

Lisy and the LoG Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 1) [PC/Mac/Linux]
notes.content:
Hey everycorgi!

Through the madness that has been Melbourne International Games Week we’ve been tinkering away on the known issues for v1.1 and solved a quite a few of them, so we thought we’d shoot you all an update as soon as we could. This patch should increase stability in multiplayer games, and allow you to play single player games while queueing for a public match! *the crowd goes wild!*

Without further ado, the changes are as follows (note: NMA stands for No More Action, a state where the game hasn’t crashed, but the flow of gameplay has stopped):
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with playing a single player game while queued for a public multiplayer game, where the public multiplayer game would load into a white screen and be stuck in an NMA state.
[*]Fixed a bug where house rules from custom single player games were persisting across to public queue multiplayer games when you were playing a singleplayer game while in the multiplayer queue.
[*]Attempting to start a single player custom game while in the multiplayer public queue will now proceed correctly.
[*]Fixed a rare case where the Host disconnecting during two other players’ combat could cause the dice to stop rolling and the game to enter an NMA state.
[*]Fixed Darkest Night King’s Declaration NMA.
[*]King’s Guards should no longer be spawned on the same tile if they are spawned during the same Dawn phase.
[*]If you leave a multiplayer party that had custom rules set, the house rules will now clear correctly.[/list]

We’ve also found another v1.1 [b]known issue, [/b]which is:
[list]
[*]If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)
[*]If you're in a private game lobby (NOT queueing for a public game) and you go play a single player game, House Rules will be reset locally (this can cause the private game to be out of sync). So don't play single player while you're waiting for a​*private*​ game.
[*]Don't change House Rules while someone is in the process of joining a private lobby - either do it before you invite them or after they've joined.[/list]

May your claws be sharp; may your wits be sound; we will meet again on Armellian ground.

<3

Lisy

notes.title: Armellians Roar! Armello's first post-release update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Heyyyy Armellians! 

In case you haven't heard, we're continuing our Early Access style of development and Armello's first major post-release update, Armellians Roar, v1.1 is here!

We had initially stated that Ranked Multiplayer would be coming with v1.1, but considering all of you had a heap of requests and cool ideas for the game, we figured we'd listen and get onto that instead. Also, we figured we'd take the chance to make our multiplayer as secure as possible. 

So here it is, v1.1, Armellians Roar! It's live on Steam right now! PS4 and DRM Free will trail a few weeks behind (as to ensure the most stable experience on those platforms). But what's inside? What are the major beats for the update? Let's check 'em out. 

[h1]Pacing Improvements[/h1]

We've gone through Armello and tweaked the timing on almost every single element in the game to ensure we're giving you the most streamlined and tailored experience. If you feel it's not quite right still, that's totally cool, because we've created more ways for you to control the pacing yourself. 

Turn 'Quick AI Turns' on or off to toggle advanced pacing on AI decisions and movement, or coolest of all, you can hit the "." key to fast-forward your off-turn in single player games. Say whaaaaat?! Yeah, that's right. You heard us. You can now fast-forward AI turns in Single Player. *Mic Drop!*

[h1]House Rules[/h1]

We know you've all been pretty keen on playing around under the hood of Armello's systems, so we've got some exciting new options in Single Player (under a new category called Custom Game) and Private Multiplayer games that we've opened up for you to all have a play around with. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/785/046/78a1ef8922e7039dd36849daec7f71bb_original.PNG?v=1446040583&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5ed2b39640cd8db97de867108b435c95[/img]

House Rules will enable you to play around with the King's Health, Heroes' Body, the power of Banes and a bunch of other cool stuff.

[h1]New Cards & Amulets[/h1]

We've added a slew of new items and especially armour(!) to the game, as well as two rad new hero amulets! 

There may even be a very special item that is a nod to some very good friends of ours and their very cool game... bonus points to those that can find it and name the game and studio below. <3

[h1]Multiplayer Stability/Security[/h1]

We've completed redesigned our multiplayer architecture in order to provide a more stable multiplayer experience. Which, excitingly means this is the first step to a reconnect feature. In fact, you may find you reconnect a little bit too. 

In addition to a more stable multiplayer experience, we've been working very closely with Valve to ensure Armello's multiplayer community is as stable as possible. 

[h1]Localisation Improvements[/h1]

We've made major improvements across all languages in order to ensure that Armello's localisation hits that League of Geeks quality that you all know and love. 

[h1]Steam Controller Support[/h1]

I'm sure there's a bunch of you that are all tinkering around with your new Steam Controllers, so we figured we'd support 'em so you can play your way. As the Steam Controller is brand new hardware, this is the first step towards full Steam Controller support. Email us at qa@leagueofgeeks.com with any Steam Controller bugs or feedback. 

[h1]Misc. fixes/improvements[/h1]

All of the above that I just mentioned, that's just the tip of the iceberg. Jump into the full patch notes (which can be found here) if you're keen on seeing all the work we've been getting up to [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=1966]here[/url]. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/785/070/2b489dbca598cedc5da94fa9fcf04d05_original.png?v=1446040856&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a9c46b1be34c847e0cf9baca72ca0cab[/img]

[h1]Development Goes On![/h1]

Free, regular, major content updates. That's what I mean when I say this is the way it is. We're going to be doing this for as long as is financially feasible. We loved working with all of you during Early Access, so we're keen to continue that trend and see this game become more incredible than we could have ever imagined. 

[h1]That's All Folks[/h1]

v1.1 is here. What are you doing still reading? Go play! Get your friends together and get going on that quest for the throne! 

<3 LoG

[*]Fixed incorrect input symbols appearing on Status Feed in Mouse+Keyboard mode.[/list]

<3

notes.title: Surprise Build Update (v1.0.1) is HERE!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UVyG46S.png[/img]

Heyo Armellians!
 
It’s been just over two weeks since launch and we wanted to give you a little somethin’ to show you that we’re here to stay and Armello is going to continue to grow and improve.
 
First up, thanks for all the kind words and we’re absolutely thrilled that you’re all loving Armello. However, we’ve also heard you loud and clear on a bunch of different ways that you feel Armello could be improved and we agree across a number of fronts. So, while we’re working on our next major update, v1.1, we thought we’d dump the following into the build.
 
What’s in v1.0.1, you ask? Well, you can check out the patch notes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=1825.0]here[/url], but if you want the TL:DR on the juicy bits, read on.
 
[h1]Improved Map Visibility When Zoomed Out[/h1]
 
Bringing the world of Armello to life was always a core goal for us, but in that process it seems we got a little bit overzealous with just how realistic things got when high above Armello. So we’ve made tweaks to a bunch of elements including fog, distance blur and depth of field. We’ve also toned down the size of the clouds.
 
These adjustments should go a long way towards improving map visibility, whilst still retaining the fidelity of Armello as a living breathing world.
 
Check the comparison below:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UgfgkxB.png[/img]
 
[h1]Selecting AI Heroes[/h1]
 
Now you can hone your Armello mastery against the Heroes of your choosing. In any game with AI present, once you’ve selected your Hero, Ring and Amulet, you’ll have the option to select the AI Heroes and their load outs.
 
If you can’t be bothered going through and selecting all their kit one by one, but feel like you want a different spread of opponents, we’ve also added a new button ‘Re-roll AI Heroes’ to get a different selection of AI Heroes.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vmKuWJe.gif[/img]
 
This new feature is perfect for training against specific hero builds or setting up epic clan wars for you and a friend.
 
[h1]More Stability, More Reliability[/h1]
 
We know that a small number of folks are experiencing drop outs in-game and even a small number is too many, so we’ve gone ahead and improved stability throughout the game and our multiplayer infrastructure.
 
We’ve also killed those few NMAs and crash bugs a few of you have experienced.
 
Also, just a reminder to use the in-game BugSender (accessed via the Pause Menu) to send us a bug report if you’re experiencing any issues with Armello. We investigate every single bug report, but we can’t fix what we don’t know about.  ;)
 
[h1]Share the Bandit Clan in Private Games[/h1]
 
As promised, backers with access to the Bandit Clan can now share them with friends in private multiplayer games. Simply invite your Steam friends to a private multiplayer game to give them access to the Bandit Clan heroes for that game.
 
For those of you that didn’t back at the Bandit Tier, get chummy with some Bandit Backers for a sneak peek at the Bandits before their public release next year.
 
[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]
 
We loved the Early Access style of development and how with all of your assistance, Armello blossomed into the special game it is today. We loved it so much in fact, that we don’t want to stop working like that.
 
So, keep the suggestions and requests coming because major content updates are going to continue rolling in. As you can already see, we’re listening.
 
You can expect us to announce v1.1 and drip feeding details within the next few weeks. 
 
[h1]What about DRM Free?[/h1]
 
For those of you hanging out for the DRM Free build, you’ll be happy to hear that our builds are complete and we’re working with GoG and Humble Bundle to get them ready to go, we’ll announce a release date and get them into your hands asap.
 
Naturally, we’ll put the soundtrack up for a DRM Free release where possible at the same time.
 
[h1]Thanks Again![/h1]
 
That’s it for v1.0.1. Remember, you can check out the patch notes [url=http://leagueofgeeks.com/forums/index.php?topic=1825.0]here[/url].
I just wanted to take the time to say thanks for joining us on this incredible journey and we can’t wait for you to see where it goes from here. We’ve still got a lot planned for Armello and with your assistance, I have no doubt we can make it happen.
 
 
<3 Lisy & the LoG Crew

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 2)
notes.content:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/418/658/2616961822773de587f87b15bfc69591_original.png?v=1441105778&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2acfe4e0ca61254b32164278e12f5c36[/img]

Hi y'all,

We've just dropped v1.0p2 and have cleaned up some issues that have been plaguing Armello.

Keep that feedback coming!

[list]
[*]The Toll Bell Sings should now no longer cause NMAs (No More Actions) when King's Guards are killed in multiplayer.
[*]King's Declarations should now always resolve correctly across the network in multiplayer games.
[*]The Early Access badge should now be correctly applied to Early Access players.
[*]Incorrect tags displaying in the buff tooltips on the Hero Shelf are now fixed.
[*]Prologue and "Pride's Edge" card description typos have been fixed.
[*]WASD camera movement controls should now work more reliably.
[*]Particle flickering should be fixed across UI elements.
[*]In Sana's act in the Prologue, the other Heroes should no longer wander through a hidden portal and take out your peril before you get a chance to.
[*]The Hero Select countdown timer has been increased.
[*]You can now select language in Armello's properties within the Steam client (per game, as opposed to per client).[/list]
[*]Shadows will now be correctly applied on higher graphics options.
[*]Having the Chat menu open will no longer delay certain game states.
[*]Fixing up a few omissions in the credits![/list]

<3

Lisy and the LoG crew!

notes.title: The Road to v1.0... and BEYOND!
notes.content:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/218/614/9be68f3d9d590af9fa1360304026a524_original.png?v=1438041945&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=01a6e58be2626c93278edda528fe22af[/img]

Hey all! 

Exciting news out of the LoG camp today! 

You may have noticed that it's a week or so past the point where we'd be announcing our next update. Well, the next update we've been working on is... v1.0! 

Annnnnd...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/124/09cf9839303a2cbf8aa2bc99d0129f8b_original.png?v=1438050352&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f7e939b919682b30851618f67e888a87[/img]

That's right, the full release of Armello will launch on September 1st. :D

Armello on PC/Mac/Linux (Steam, Humble Store, GoG, and more) and PlayStation 4 (PSN) will all be available on September 1st.

We initially planned to be on Early Access for six months. We celebrated that milestone just a few days ago on July 22nd. Now it's time for the next part of this journey, because believe it or not, this isn't the end. Not even close. 

We'd hate to spoil all our plans, but here's what we can tell you about Armello's roadmap moving forward.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qJNjtxR.png[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/131/776bb647b0593b89f9a6ba8b5fcfaed3_original.png?v=1438050414&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a40a3bad2d73d9114fbcf8bb3e9422e1[/img]

When v1.0 launches on September 1st, it will be available in TWELVE languages!
[list]
[*]English
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Brazilian Portugese
[*]Dutch
[*]Russian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Simplified Chinese[/list]

Annnnnd a whole-nother language we haven't even announced yet... Polish! 

Yep. Basically, we loved The Witcher 3 so much we wanted to make sure the devs could play Armello. lol

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/770/6cbb9c49b4dda169901fbde8ad9f3045_original.png?v=1438059714&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5ea0374105815b99ae58646d25a6f1af[/img]

At the end of this coming week, on August 1st, the Early Access version of Armello will come down from sale. This week will be the last chance you'll have to buy Armello before the release of v1.0.

[b]For the entire month of August, Armello will not be available for purchase. [/b]

If you or your pals wish to buy Armello while it's still in Early Access you have approximately 5 days to do so. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/158/21ec9ba39bfc209c9d5b4b84125fae48_original.png?v=1438050718&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7f3db879bd3664f0d47b81401a883ae3[/img]

As stated all along, Armello's final price was to be decided closer to launch. Well, now we're officially "closer to launch" and after listening to all the commentary and feedback from the community, press, and our peers, we're happy to announce that Armello will be $19.99 USD on both PC and PS4 at launch.  

We're also super excited to announce that due to popular demand, there will be a 4 pack available on Steam. You'll be able to buy four copies of Armello for the price of three. 

For those of you who bought the game in Early Access at $24.99 USD, don't stress, we've got good news... 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/137/f9cc33cfefadb33544adb14c9943b6d9_original.png?v=1438050494&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=50469bec30794c07c82adac512c0d35d[/img]

Words simply cannot express how grateful we are for all of your support during the pre-release development of Armello. From the presents, fan art and letters that so many of you have sent to us here at the studio, to the incredible laughs we've had on the forums, when reading your reviews and of course during the streams. But most of all, for all your honest, considered, and mind-blowingly-insightful feedback along the way that has made Armello that game we had visions of almost five years ago now. 

Considering words can't express this gratitude, we figured free stuff would be a good place to start. So, all pre-release players will receive...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/026/b617d2485fa76a7c29c84cd56526d382_original.png?v=1438049379&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=e340d6bffd1bddc68f13e038ab41b8c8[/img]
[i]Concepts pictured above. Final dice and badge may differ slightly.[/i]

[b]A free digital copy of the Armello soundtrack at launch. [/b]

That's right. The unanimously praised Armello OST, composed by Michael Allen and Lisa Gerrard will be gifted to all of you via Steam.

[b]Unique Early Access themed in-game dice! [/b]

Yep. In-game dice! Ty's concepted up these crazy cool Early Access dice and we're getting 'em in-game this week. You'll be able to use these in all areas of the game. 

[b]A unique in-game Early Access badge![/b]

All Early Access players can play Armello with a new found pride showing off their dedication to Armello and letting the world know that Armello is what it is today because they were here before it was cool. ;)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/191/db9c177efe5a91b65187d27b2ca15e6d_original.png?v=1438051177&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a2eecd63f3f98b103a76b5970036c533[/img]

We've always known that v1.0 was never going to be the end for Armello, but there's been a lot of talk about how we'll be delivering updates. 

The arrival of v1.0 marks a huge milestone in the project. This is the game we set out to make. After almost five years, and with thanks to all of you, we've done it! But! We have so many things we'd still love to experiment with for Armello, so instead of just saying, "thanks! maybe next game", we're gonna try get them in-game post-launch. 

This will take the form of a mixture of free and paid, major updates.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/773/9286461cd03da1b014eeb2fe22edc32b_original.png?v=1438059767&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=d7c2500769a06f419da0e62299cee7cd[/img]

Ranked Multiplayer has been on the Main Menu for a long time and we're super proud to announce that the Ranked Season is on schedule to go live a month or so after launch in Armello's first major update, v1.1 - which... will be completely free.  

Not only do we need time to fine tune the balance of Armello v1.0's multiplayer at launch, but we want everyone to have enough time to hone their skills and get acquainted with the finer strategies of Armello before, well, throwing you all against each other.

As we do with all our updates, we'll be releasing more information about Ranked multiplayer as we near the release of v1.1.

We might even have some other very exciting multiplayer features coming to Armello in post-launch updates... but you'll just have to wait to find out what they may or may not be. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/220/007/19ff72b32cbeb5cb2e3fb75d9a4e7e79_original.png?v=1438065086&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=08456ab0d7e4d8fa2e5b682b5d681c5a[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/599/374bfd9ff4998051601df9356efc475a_original.png?v=1438057280&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=03be4049855eadf76bc6ffa8678a92ca[/img]

I would say "the end is in sight because of you all," but like I said, this isn't the end. So instead, on behalf of everyone who's ever worked on Armello, I thank you for joining us on this journey and for being by our side at this very important point in Armello's life and League of Geeks' history. 

We <3 you forever and ever. You da best. 

Be sure to stay tuned to the LoG feeds as we'll be announcing all the v1.0 stuff in the coming weeks. :D

[b]<3 Trent and the LoG Crew[/b]

notes.title: The Road to v1.0... and BEYOND!

Hey all! 

Exciting news out of the LoG camp today! 

You may have noticed that it's a week or so past the point where we'd be announcing our next update. Well, the next update we've been working on is... v1.0! 

Annnnnd...

Armello on PC/Mac/Linux (Steam, Humble Store, GoG, and more) and PlayStation 4 (PSN) will all be available on September 1st.

We initially planned to be on Early Access for six months. We celebrated that milestone just a few days ago on July 22nd. Now it's time for the next part of this journey, because believe it or not, this isn't the end. Not even close.

[list]

[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Brazilian Portugese
[*]Dutch
[*]Russian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Simplified Chinese[/list]

Annnnnd a whole-nother language we haven't even announced yet... Polish! 

Yep. Basically, we loved The Witcher 3 so much we wanted to make sure the devs could play Armello. lol

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/770/6cbb9c49b4dda169901fbde8ad9f3045_original.png?v=1438059714&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5ea0374105815b99ae58646d25a6f1af[/img]

[b]For the entire month of August, Armello will not be available for purchase. [/b]

If you or your pals wish to buy Armello while it's still in Early Access you have approximately 5 days to do so. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/219/158/21ec9ba39bfc209c9d5b4b84125fae48_original.png?v=1438050718&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7f3db879bd3664f0d47b81401a883ae3[/img]
